    [i]Not a Member of the [b]Unofficial[/b] Dragon Saga Discord[/i]?    [url=https://discord.gg/w8wssud]        Join the DragonSaga Inn    [/url]    [b][/b]

    [b][/b]

    [b]Item Mall:  Blue Crystal 
    [/b]Blue Crystals can be obtained from the Item Mall and are used to    exchange them at the new [i]Blue Vending Machine (Item Mall Vendor)[/i] –    see below.

    1 Blue  Crystal costs 10 IM points and can be traded for a fixed price of 70    Gold once (which  equals a ratio of 1:7).    
    [b]        [i]Important: Don't try to bypass the fixed price because doing that        results in a permanent  ban! 
        [/i]    [/b]    After selling the Blue Crystals they become [b]fully[/b] restricted    including Account Vault. 
    
    The Blue Crystals can be purchased as packages of 1 piece (10 IM), 10 pcs.    (100  IM) and 100 pcs. (1000 IM). 
    
    Currently they can be found at the [i]Special[/i] tab but they likely will    be  moved to a different tab in the next weeks. [b][i] 
    [/i][/b] 
    


    [b][/b]

    [b]Two new  Vending Machines 
    [/b]At Ports of the Winds Center Island you can find 2 new Vending    Machines.

    [b][i]Red Vending Machine: In-Game Item Vendor 
    [/i][/b]At this machine you can exchange [i]10  Eternal Coins[/i]for    [i]        5 Red Crystals.    [/i]    The [i]Red Crystals are[/i] the currency for the In-Game Item Vendor. At    that  Vending Machine you can obtain some in-game items. The currently    available Items  are: 
    
    - 10x Chaos Energy Dust (25 Red Crystals) 
    - Ice Dragon Gear Parts for your class (40 Red Crystals each) 
    - Ice Dragon Weapon for your class with randomly given Special Options (50    Red  Crystals)

    
    All items have the "sold" status and cannot be traded. Account  Vaulting is    possible. The Red Crystals are fully restricted including Account  Vault.

    [b] 
    [i]Blue Vending Machine: Item Mall  Vendor 
    [/i][/b]At this machine you can exchange [i]Blue  Crystals[/i]which can be    purchased from the Item Mall for several items which  are: 
    
    - 10x W-Coin (80 Blue Crystals) 
    - 11x Insurance Scroll (7 Blue Crystals) 
    - 11x Advanced Insurance Scroll (9 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Reinforced Insurance Scroll (8 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Advanced Reinforced Insurance Scroll (10 Blue Crystals) 
    - 5x Prime Pixel Insurance Scroll (15 Blue Crystals) 
    - 5x Card Insurance Scroll (16 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Soulcraft Randomizer (24 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Advanced Soulcraft Randomizer (32 Blue Crystals) 
    - 1x Special Option Creator (60 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Special Option Randomizer (100 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Pet Option Randomizer (32 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Advanced Pet Option Randomizer (42 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Ring Coin (30 Blue Crystals) 
    - 10x Chaos Energy Dust (20 Blue Crystals) 
    - Ice Dragon Gear Parts for your class (30 Blue Crystals each) 
    - Ice Dragon Weapon for your class with randomly given Special Options (40    Blue  Crystals)

    
    All items have the "sold" status and cannot be traded. Account  Vaulting is    possible. 
    


    Additionally  you can exchange [i]750 Eternal Coins[/i]for    [i]        5 Blue Crystals.    [/i]    The Blue Crystals  you got from that exchange are fully restricted    (including Account Vault).
[b] 
[/b]
    [b][/b]

    [b]Special Limited Time Exchange 
    [/b]You can exchange [i]100 W-Coins[/i] for the [i]Legendary Item Box #1[/i]    which randomly contains one of these [b]legendary[/b] costume items which    are  one-time sellable: 
    
    - Legendary Low Rider Glasses 
    - Master Sprayer Headphones 
    - Legendary Evolution Wings

    [/b][b]This event has ended.[/b]You can still exchange Event Items at the    [i]Vending Machine[/i] until [b]May  22, 11:00 Server Time.[/b]

    [b]Nostalgia Backpack  Event 
    [/b]Collect DDDD items by killing monsters inside Expert Modes, Dungeons    and Mission Maps starting with Mirinae Sanctuary and trade them together    with [i]Gada  Coins[/i] for a Nostalgia Quiver Box, Nostalgia Wing Box,    Nostalgia Muffler Box  or Nostalgia Cape Box for your particular class.    
    
    [b]Important:[/b]    [i]        The Items are class specific! 
        
        The Cape Box contains Capes for the Knight and Gladiator class path.        
        The Wing Box contains Wings for the Monk and Wizard class path. 
        The Quiver Box contains Quivers for Hunter and Marksman class path.        
        The Muffler Box contains Mufflers for the Bandit and Infiltrator class        path. 
        
        All 4 boxes have a chance of around 7.69% to give Heirloom Kimart Wings        which  can be worn by all classes. 
    [/i]    
    [b]This event stays until May 29, 11:00  Server Time.[/b] [b]

This year you will get the  green Leprechaun Costume    consisting of Hat, Jacket, Pants, bare Hands, Shoes  and the Pot  of Gold    (Backpack) again.  The Pot of Gold give very special stats: Teleport cost    discount: 15%  (overridden if the pet skill is available) and Repair cost    reduction: 10% (this  stat does not "stack"). The costume has the common    event costume  stats. The whole costume is tradable/sellable but soulbound    upon equip.

    [b]Cookie  Factory is back!

    [b]Chocolate Meister's House and  Chocolate Storage 
    [/b]Open the doors to  Chocolate Meister's House and the Chocolate Storage    by playing the initial  questline. It starts at NPC Floran at Port of the    Winds. The quest will show up  for all players Level 30+.

    [b]Chocolate Meister's House (Event Map  F6 Mode) 
    [/b]To access this mode  you need to have Tickets to Chocolate Meister's    House (F6) [2020] in your  inventory. They're working like the defense    orders. One is needed for a party  size up to 2 players and two tickets are    needed for parties of 3 and 4 players.  The tickets can be obtained from the    initial questline and by killing  Monsters inside Expert Modes, Dungeons    (except of Galaxy Dungeon, Element  Dungeons and Temple of Water) and    Mission Maps starting with Mirinae Sanctuary. 
    
    No Perfect Hunches are needed to get the directions guessing rewards.    Instead  you will need Magical Flower Bouquets. You can obtain Magical    Flower Boxes  containing up to 3 Magical Flower Bouquets inside Expert    Modes, Dungeons  (except of Galaxy Dungeon, Element Dungeons and Temple of    Water) and Mission  Maps starting with Mirinae Sanctuary. When you are asked    to guess the monster direction you can use the  Magical Flower Bouquet to    always have a right guess. 
    For every right guess you will be rewarded with the following:

    [/b][b]Since December 1st the NPCs at Port of the Winds have a small gift    for you. 
    [/b]Everyday another NPC at PoW  will have a Christmas Gift for you. Just go    and grab it once per day for each  character which is Level 40+. You will    get one gift everyday until December,  25th. [b][/b]

    [b]X-Mas Event 2024[/b] 
    The X-Mas Event will bring you back the X-Mas Mission Map. The event lasts    until [b]January 2, 11:00 Server Time.[/b][b][i] 
    [/i][/b] [b] 
    X-Mas Event Mission Map[/b] 
    The X-Mas Mission Map consist of Arcade (F1) Mode, Chaos (F2) Mode and two    Scenario Modes (F5). The first Scenario Mode is for the initial questline    and  the second one is for the daily quest.


    [u]Possible mission rewards are:[/u][b] 
    [/b] [i]Arcade (F1) Mode: 
    [/i] 
    Armor Enchant Dust 
    Weapon Enchant Dust 
    Souls 
    EXP Double Up Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins.) 
    X-Mas Ballon Box (contains different balloons only) 
    X-Mas Accessory Box (contains different X-Mas accessories like the Carrot    Nose) 
    X-Mas Santa Costume Box (contains Santa Costume in Pink, Red, Green and    White) 
    X-Mas Furniture Box (Arcade) (contains different MyHome furniture) 
    Frost Weapon Box (contains Frost Weapons) 
    


    [i]Chaos (F2) Mode: 
    [/i] 
    Armor Enchant Dust 
    Weapon Enchant Dust 
    Souls 
    EXP Double Up Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins.) 
    X-Mas Ballon Box (contains different balloons only) 
    X-Mas Accessory Box (contains different X-Mas accessories like the Carrot    Nose) 
    X-Mas Santa Costume Box (contains Santa Costume in Pink, Red, Green and    White) 
    X-Mas Furniture Box (Chaos) (contains different MyHome furniture) 
    Magical Ice Weapon Box (contains Magical Ice Weapons) 
    
    Besides this all boss monsters drop Christmas cookies (food for HP/MP    regeneration)

    [b]Main Questline 
    [/b]After completing 6 quests you will be able to run F5 Scenario Mode daily    to  obtain 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can    be  exchanged for a X-Mas Costume Box.

    [b]The 12 Quests of Christmas[/b] 
    Beginning with December, 14th you will get a new quest of the quest    collection  "The 12 Quests of Christmas" daily until December, 25th. The    "job" for each of these quests is all around the X-Mas Event Mission  Map.    The quests can be done until December 26, 23:59 Server Time. Every quest    gives you 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can    be  exchanged for a winter themed car mount (Winter Rover) or a winter    themed sheep  mount (Frosty Flix). Also you will get a brand new X-Mas    achievement.

    [i]        Please notice that the car/sheep is neither  tradable/sellable nor        account vaultable.    [/i]

    
    [b]        Drop Event 
        Collect [i]Santa[/i] [i]Christmas Boxes (2022)[/i] which need to be        opened with [i]Santa Key (2022).[/i]    [/b]    [i][/i]The key can be obtained by exchanging it for [i]Burned    Cookies[/i](see below).[b] 
    [/b]The box  randomly gives you one of the following: [b][/b]
[b] 
[/b]
    [b][/b]

    [b][/b]

    [b]Collect [i]Burned  Cookies[/i] to exchange them for different items:[/b]    
    
    - One [i]Santa Key (2022)[/i]for 4 Burned  Cookies 
    - One EXP Biscuit for 10 Burned Cookies (1.9x EXP for 30 mins.) 
    [i]The Biscuit has to be used within one day. Otherwise it expires.[/i]

[h1] Maintenance Notes [/h1]

2024-11-14, 11:00 Server Time


[h1] I Like! Event  [/h1]

This Event continues until November 21, 11:00 Server Time.

For more details have a look at the Patch Notes from November 7.

[h1] Graphics Update: More Lighting Rework [/h1]

And once again our Map Maker provided us with more of his pretty lighting reworks for another 2 mission map areas: Pine Cone Hills and God's Sanctuary. Take a look at these mission maps to see how pretty they now look!



[h1] QoL Update: Flashing Button Options  [/h1]

On Community Wish we have added new options how the Flashing Buttons (Market and PvP) behave. At the Misc Options tab you will find these new options:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/405ff483386f32a6f4b06be1f492cf6d4d19c4fa.png[/img]
 
For the Market Button you can choose if it shall always flash (when you sold something), if the flashing shall be disabled when you're running a Mission Map or Dungeon or if it should never flash. 
Changes to this settings are effective after a map change, channel change, character change or re-login.
For the PvP Button Flash (which appears when Battlesquare starts) you can only decide if you want to see the flash (Always) or if the flash should be disabled (Never). The PvP button flash does not appear when you are running Mission Maps/Dungeons by design, also the PvP flash is only triggered when you hear the BSQ notification. It does not start to flash later which means, if you are currently in a mission map or dungeon when you hear the BSQ notification, the button will not flash when you leave the map. Also it's not possible to disable the flash effect when it's currently flashing. The setting will become effective for the next BSQ notification.

Scaling Dungeons and Mission Maps (Early Access)
Ever wanted to play with your lower character level friend without the need of creating a new character to match your friend's level? We got you, now you can.
We are proud to introduce our Scaling Dungeons and Mission Maps feature.

From now on when entering a Dungeon or Mission Map with low and high level characters together in a party the Dungeons and Mission Maps are level scaling the high level characters to match the lower level ones.

How it works
When entering a Dungeon/Mission Map the game finds out the lowest character level of all party members. All other party members within a threshold of 5 levels are notscaled, while the characters that have a character level beyond that threshold are automatically scaled to the character with the highest level within the threshold.

Example:
Your party consist of 4 characters: a Lv. 21 one, a Lv. 24 one, a Lv. 22 one and a Lv. 84 one. The Lv. 21 one is the character with the lowest level in the party and is considered the base level for that party. All characters between Lv. 21 and Lv. 25 are within the 5 level threshold and are not scaled. So the Lv. 21, Lv. 22 and Lv. 24 characters stay unscaled while the Lv. 84 character is scaled down to Lv. 24 (which is the character with the highest Level within the threshold).

What is scaled
For characters which are scaled down, only PATK/MATK, PDef/MDef and the Element Damage (Attack) is scaled. All other stats remain unscaled (for example Critical Damage, Final Damage Reduction, etc.).
The particular scaled stats are always scaled to the highest value of all unscaled players (low level) in the party separately.

Benefits for the scaled Characters
While being in a scaled party, the scaled characters will get rewards at the end of the Dungeon/Mission Map again as long as the usual requirements are met (10% Damage Rule, no Dungeon rewards when the players are 10 levels above the Dungeon Entry Level, getting an appropriate score for the Mission Maps). Also monsters are dropping items (including Event Drops) again. This mean you can now no longer not only help your low level friends finishing their quests but instead become able to actively play and farm dungeons and mission maps together with them again no matter what your own higher character level is.

Another benefit is that you get EXP again while being in a scaled party. Also your low level friends get your shared Party EXP. One exception is scaled parties cannot be used to farm ExCos since a Lv. 85 character does not get EXP themselves but share the Party EXP to the other party members which are not Lv.85 yet.

While a player is not able to use skills which are not available at the scaled character level you are able to use skills whose Level 1 character level requirement matches your scaled level. That means if you have a skill Level of 10 on a particular skill and the level requirement for the skill level 1 is met you can continue using this particular skill on Skill Level 10.

Where there is Light there is also Shadow
The are some limitations regarding the end rewards when playing in a scaled party:

Mission Maps
For each scaled high level player in a party the whole party gets 1 end reward less.
In numbers:
1 High Level Player in the Party – 3 Rewards per Person
2 High Level Players in the Party – 2 Rewards per Person
3 High Level Players in the Party – 1 Reward per Person

Dungeons
If there is more than one high level player in a party the whole party gets 1 end reward less for every additional high level player.
In numbers:
1 High Level Player in the Party – 4 Rewards per Person
2 High Level Players in the Party – 3 Rewards per Person
3 High Level Players in the Party – 2 Rewards per Person

Expert Mode Dungeons are excluded from this system and no changes have been made to them.

Why it's Early Access?
Because having Early Access is trending nowadays...
Seriously, this is a whole new system and needs to be tested on a live server environment.
Early Access means that this or that could become subject to change if we find out that it does not works out how we planned it or in case of bugs and unforseen happenings. The additional Early Access shall inform you that things can change again until we make this system a full release.


The downscaled Level can be seen at different locations. Also the scaled stats are reflected in the character overview.



Quest Completer Item (Item Mall)
We have implemented a new Item Mall item called Quest Completer . This item works only for Hero Quests (Red Quests, JobChange Quests) up to Level 75. A specific Amount of this Item can be used to immediately complete such quests. The only exception is the quest 3rd Class Promotion - [Achievement and Hidden Map] Advice from Hel Krouzer which is excluded from being completed with the help of this item. All other Hero Quests and JobChange Quests have now a button added called "Skip" when the quest has been accepted and you open the quest inside your journal or by clicking on the quest tracker. Clicking on "Skip" will inform you about the amount of the Quest Completer Item needed to immediately complete the particular quest.

Important Information: Completing a quest this way will grant you all quest rewards of the particular quest (EXP, Gold and Items).

After successfully using the "Skip" function your quest has the completed state. You still have to finish the quest completion process remotely (if possible) or at the Quest NPC if needed.
Completing a dungeon or mission map related quest this way will not give you any mission map or dungeon end rewards.

The amount of Quest Completer Items needed to complete a specific quest depends on the quest level (except of JobChange Quests):
1~19: 1 Item per Quest
20~29: 2 Items per Quest
30~39: 3 Items per Quest
40~49: 4 Items per Quest
50~59: 5 Items per Quest
60~69: 6 Items per Quest
70~75: 7 Items per Quest

JobChange Quests need 10 Items per Quest to be skipped no matter the quest level.

Important Information: The level requirements for the particular quest stays which means that you still have to progress (level up) your character to unlock higher level hero quests!

The Quest Completer Item is one-time sellabe for all characters Lv. 50+.

    [b]Daily  Quest Changes[/b]

    [b][/b]

    We've made changes to the Hunter G., Mummy Andre, and Guild  Daily Quests.    The Daily Quests now include tasks that must be completed  individually by    each party member. For instance, if you're tasked with killing  70 Monster X    at location Y and it is marked as an individual quest, only the  monsters    you personally defeat will count toward the quest, not those killed by  your    party members. This applies to all daily quests except for combo quests or    those involving mini-bosses in dungeons. 
    Additionally, the individual quests vary from day to day. The number of    individual  quests is not fixed and changes daily. In simple terms, a quest    that requires  you to work alone today may allow party assistance on another    day, and vice  versa. 
    


    These individual quests are marked with a new symbol, which  can be seen in    the daily quest list and the quest details:

    [b]Event: [u]Floran's Flowers[/u][/b] 
    It's Summer and Floran, the Inn Keeper of the Vyvern Lounge, decided that    some  flowers would give a pretty look. As luck would have it, Orhah is in    town to  take care of some things. Of course you know about Orhah's    beautiful rose  garden. Maybe you should go and talk to her (she can be    found on the center  island at Port of the Winds) and ask if she would be    willing to give you some  as a gift for Floran.

    And yes she will, but... 
    ... of course not for free.

    Complete Orhah's tasks to get your hands on the flowers.  Three in total.    After you collected all 3 go to Floran and [u]trade[/u] the 3  roses for a    little something in return. Both, Floran and you, will end up being  very    happy!

    Go to NPC Orhah at Port of the Winds Center and she will give you a sequence    of  3 quets.

    When trading the 3 roses with NPC Floran you will get a box  containing the    following:

[b]Ancestor System – Part 2[/b]
In the year 2017 we introduced Part 1 of the Ancestor System. Now we are proud that we finally implemented Part 2 of the system.

[i]What's New[/i]
At NPC Lucius you are now able to get 2* Ancestory Accessory Items for 2 ExCo each. These can be equipped on Lv. 85 characters. It is required to have the same 1* Ancestory Accessory Item equipped before you can equip the 2* one. The 1* Items is then replaced by the 2* Item giving you higher stats than the 1*. [b]The 2* Ancestor Accessory Items can only be equipped on Level 85 characters.[/b]

[i]What has changed?[/i]
The 1* Ancestor Accessory items stop working (stop giving additional stats) as soon as your character becomes Lv. 85 and the text with the level requirement now turns red. If you want additional stats from Ancestor Items on a Lv. 85 character you need to farm 2* Items and replace the 1* ones.[b]1* Ancestor Accessory Items are only giving additional stats to characters Lv. 20~84.[/b]


[b]NPC Lucius ExCo Exchange Update[/b]
At NPC Lucius you can now get the 2* Ancestor Accessory Items for 2 ExCo each and the [b][Regular] Prime Pixel (PATK)[/b]> and [b][Regular] Prime Pixel (MATK)[/b] for 3 ExCo each.

[b]Valentine's Day Event 2023 – Event Guide
Cookie Factory is back![/b]
Stop Derek from kidnapping children and poisoning sweets and candies.

[b]Chocolate Meister's House and Chocolate Storage[/b]
Open the doors to Chocolate Meister's House and the Chocolate Storage by playing the initial questline. It starts at NPC Floran at Port of the Winds. The quest will show up for all players Level 30+.
Chocolate Meister's House (Event Map F6 Mode)
To access this mode you need to have Tickets to Chocolate Meister's House (F6) [2020] in your inventory. They're working like the defense orders. One is needed for a party size up to 2 players and two tickets are needed for parties of 3 and 4 players. The tickets can be obtained from the initial questline and as a world drop (by killing any monster).

No Perfect Hunches are needed to get the directions guessing rewards. Instead you will need Magical Flower Bouquets. You can obtain Magical Flower Boxes containing up to 3 Magical Flower Bouquets by killing monsters on any hidden (scroll) map. Those hidden scrolls are dropped by any boss of the regular mission maps. Hidden maps are available for all level ranges. When you are asked to guess the monster direction you can use the Magical Flower Bouquet to always have a right guess.
For every right guess you will be rewarded with the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/b47680f10918e15cfc0f1fea5f7cdc94a3cdebfd.png[/img]

5 Valentine Silver Coins can be traded at NPC Gordon in Port of the Winds to obtain a Valentine's Silver Accessory Box. This box can contain a part of the Lovely Silver Accessory Set or a Valentine's Day consumable item.

You can trade in 2 specific parts of the Lovely Silver Accessory Set to get one Lovey Gold Accessory Set part at NPC Gordon.

10 Valentine Gold Coins can be traded at NPC Gordon for a Amor Box. This box randomly contains a part of the Cupid Set or the Amor Angel Set.

20 Valentine Gold Coins can be traded at NPC Gordon for an [Event] Styling Pink Box. This box randomly contains a part of the [Event] Styling Pink Set.

[b]Please know that all boxes are fully restricted.[/b]
At Stage 5 and Stage 10 you get a stage end reward similar to the mission result rewards. You will get 4 random rewards out of the following:

The recipe box can be obtained from the F1 Mode and is given by Cookie Ingredient Boxes.

[b]Couple Questline[/b]
When playing as a couple or married couple and after completing the quest "Proof of Love" you will be able to start a questline especially for couples to obtain parts of this year's valentine's day event costume set. For finishing the last quest of this quest line you will get the Valentine's Day achievement (Be my Valentine), 2 Love Message Cards, 5 Love Love Warps and a Valentine's Pet Gift Coupon. With this coupon you can get one of three Valentine Pets:

[b]X-Mas Calendar Event[/b]
Since December, 1st the NPCs at Port of the Winds have a small gift for you.
Everyday another NPC at PoW will have a Christmas Gift for you. Just go and grab it once per day for each character which is Level 40+. You will get one gift everyday until December 25th.

[b]X-Mas 12 Days of Christmas Questline[/b]
The 12 Days of Christmas Questline has started on December 14, 0:00 Server Time. It is available at the Santa NPC so make sure you already rescued him.

[b]X-Mas Event 2022[/b]
The X-Mas Event will bring you back the X-Mas Mission Map. The event lasts until December 28, 11:00 Server Time.

[b]X-Mas Quest Line The Gift of Christmas[/b]
Starting at December 19, 0:00 Server Time a special daily event quest will be available at Port of the Winds. You can get it from The Princess of the Town NPC. It is a seven days long questline which can only be completed if you accept and complete the daily event quest. Each quest will only be available for 24 hours and there is no possibility to take them later. You have to accept and complete each of them on the day they appear. Each of the quests comes with a special clue which is shown to you by Princessia's quest dialog on completion so make sure you do not skip the quest dialog and read it and remember what the NPC told you. You will need it to complete the whole questline. You will not be able to solve the final quest without completing all 7 daily quests yourself. The hints of other players will do nothing for you. If you skipped a day the last quest will not show up for you and you won't be able to get anything. This questline is available for all characters Level 40+ and it is fully intended that the last quest does not have a quest indicator nor will not appear in the quest lists or journal. This is because you are on a gift hunt which requires all seven clues to be able to find the Gift of Christmas. The 7th clue will be available on December 25 and you have to find the last quest on the same day. It will disappear on December 26, 0:00 Server Time. If you think you found what you have to look for, stand in front of it and press your NPC interaction key (default is Space). Good hunting!

- Bugfix: Fixed a bug where the flags on the channel selection background is always showing the EU flag, no matter which region is shown

[b]Port of the Winds Farm – Important Notice[/b]
[b]As mentioned in the last patch notes we decided to remove the possibility to sell or trade Farm materials (gathered from the Port of the Winds Farm, including the blessed items) to other players using the open market, trade or in-game mail.[/b] Also the price for selling these items to an NPC Shop will be reduced to 1 copper per item. The only possibility to share these items with other characters will be the Account Vault in the future. Produced items (like the EXP Devices etc.) will be not affected by this and can be sold to others normally.
[b]This is now effective.[/b]

[b]The next Layer of Protection – Easy Anti Cheat[/b]
We are proud to announce that we have added another layer of protection against hacking and cheating by adding [b]Easy Anti Cheat[/b] to the game. Taking this step shall make your game experience even better. 
There is no step to take on your end since the EAC installation happens automatically during game start.

[b]It could happen that the Windows Security asks you to allow that the EasyAntiCheat installer can be installed. Please accept that otherwise the game can't run.[/b]

[i]Technical Info: Please know that the now needs a 64-bit Operating System to run, even though the game itself is still a 32-bit application.[/i]

[b]General Fixes and Changes[/b]
[b]- Bugfix:[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes when opening lots of in-game boxes shortly after another items went missing (for example it happened with Ancient Relic Boxes and does not happen with IM boxes). A 300ms delay between each box opening has been added to prevent this to happen. Additionally the bug that it had a very long delay when opening boxes by mouseclick has been removed. It's now as fast as opening them using them from the quick slot.
[b]- Bugfix:[/b] You can no longer try to trade friend points when being max level. This never really worked and so the menu for trading friend points has been removed for max level characters (currently Lv. 85 characters).

[b]Pirate's Hideout Event[/b]

Arg me mateys! The great Pirate Hideout has been discovered in Dragon Saga!

There be a new event mission map in town, and it be for all level o' players beyond level 25, with monsters that scale to yer level! Run the Pirate's Hideout F1 Mission Map to obtain marvelous treasures in the form of mission rewards. 

Once ye have made it through the perilous gauntlet of Pirates and scallywags, at the end of this mission you will see two deadly bosses. One of them is the terrifying Hookah, but the other changes with the shifting sea! You will either face off with Alvida or Kalygon. Once you have battled these monstrous foes, they will drop grand pirate treasure chests! Be ye careful though, all monsters in the finale boss room will have to be killed to complete the map.

You may find inside this treasure chest a Slice of Cake, Yogurt, a Balloon, a treasure piece or, if ye be unlucky, junk! Don't worry though; you can always be selling the junk treasure for 10 silver to any shop NPC.

What about them glittery treasure pieces ye ask? The treasure pieces be needed to be exchanged to a Chucky's Clothing Gasha Box, which may be randomly yields a pirate clothing or th' mighty rare animated Moby Whale balloon. Where have you seen him before?

[b]As fer them shiny mission end rewards, ye can get:[/b]

Repair Hammers
An EXP potion
Weapon Enchant Dust
Armor Enchant Dust

[b]Souls[/b]
A Pirate's Weapon Gasha Box (only S~SSS Rank)
Pirate's Diamonds (only S~SSS Rank)

Ye can also trade 4 Golden Woodie Statues, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Woodie Statues at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Barter ye Booty' (level 25+). If ye be wanting to unlock this repeatable quest you have to complete Hookah's 'Enter th' Hideout' Quest (Level 25+) once on yer pirate fightin' character.
Ye can get get a Pirate Clothing Chest or an [Event] Cpt. Woodstock Support Matey.
Th' [Event] Cpt. Woodstock Matey can be upgraded to a High Stat Support Matey usin' th' Pet Upgrader Item from the Item Mall at NPC Amy's shoppe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/3b0ce8dffc90d04ef261a54596f11d0ed35c0cda.png[/img]
 
And if ye have some of them Pirate Diamonds, ye can trade 10 at a time at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Shiny Diamonds' (Level 25+) for a Big IM Consumable Gasha Box which randomly yields Event IM Consumables.

So go get that pirate treasure, before the time is up, and those scurvy pirates sail back out to sea!

What could be better than going to the beach, jumping into the cool water and enjoying the summer sun, looking at all the palm trees while having a cool Pineapple Drink and listening to some Reggae Music? The full Jamaica feeling hits Port of the Winds – the whole day – and from dusk til dawn. But the summer in Dragon Saga is more than just being lazy! Fight monsters and get some nice event stuff! [b]Dragon Saga Evolved – Kryos Origins[/b]

Did you ever wanted to know why Kryos is only a weak Mission Map boss instead of being a furious Dungeon Boss? Finally you can get the answer. Take a journey into the past  lands of Dragon Saga and find out!

[b]This Update contains the following:[/b]
- a whole new Dungeon
- 2 new Field Maps
- a Lv. 75 Gear Set: the Ice Dragon Set for every class which can be gotten from the Dungeon
- a new Lv. 75 Ice Weapon which can hold Soul Gems

[b]Players of the World UNITE! Event[/b]
[b]1st EU Comeback Anniversary[/b]
One year has passed since the DragonSaga players from Europe – the Heroes in Exile – were able to come back to the world of DragonSaga. 

We thought this would be a great opportunity to celebrate this with a special event to every player on this server – to the ones who stayed with us for all this time and for the ones who were finally able to return last year after three years of being in exile.
The players of the world united again and everyone is still welcome, no matter from which country they come. 

This is an event for everyone!
For all Dragon Saga Players of the World!

This event will last two weeks filled with different types of events:
Grind Event, 2 Questchains, a special EXP Event and hopefully a lot of fun!

Player's of the World Unite (Level 20+)
Start NPC is Pororing at the monument at Port of the Winds

Valentine's Day Event 2022 – Event Guide
Cookie Factory is back!
Stop Derek from kidnapping children and poisoning sweets and candies.
Chocolate Meister's House and Chocolate Storage
Open the doors to Chocolate Meister's House and the Chocolate Storage by playing the initial questline. It starts at NPC Floran at Port of the Winds. The quest will show up for all players Level 30+.

Chocolate Meister's House (Event Map F6 Mode)
To access this mode you need to have Tickets to Chocolate Meister's House (F6) [2020] in your inventory. They're working like the defense orders. One is needed for a party size up to 2 players and two tickets are needed for parties of 3 and 4 players. The tickets can be obtained from the initial questline and as a world drop (by killing any monster).

No Perfect Hunches are needed to get the directions guessing rewards. Instead you will need Magical Flower Bouquets. You can obtain Magical Flower Boxes containing up to 3 Magical Flower Bouquets by killing monsters on any hidden (scroll) map. Those hidden scrolls are dropped by any boss of the regular mission maps. Hidden maps are available for all level ranges. When you are asked to guess the monster direction you can use the Magical Flower Bouquet to always have a right guess.

For every right guess you will be rewarded with the following:

Right Guesses	1 Player Party	2 Players Party	3 Players Party	4 Players Party
1-3	1x Sweet Ingredients Box	2x Sweet Ingredients Box	3x Sweet Ingredients Box	4x Sweet Ingredients Box
4	1x Valentine Silver Coin	2x Valentine Silver Coin	3x Valentine Silver Coin	4x Valentine Silver Coin
5-8	1x Sweet Ingredients Box	2x Sweet Ingredients Box	3x Sweet Ingredients Box	4x Sweet Ingredients Box
9	1x Valentine Gold Coin Box	1x Valentine Gold Coin Box	2x Valentine Gold Coin Box	2x Valentine Gold Coin Box

The scrolls to travel to a specific floor have been removed. Instead you will be now be able to enter the floor you already visited directly by selecting it from the new floor selection window.

"Why are pirates pirates? cuz they arrrrrr"

Pirate's Hideout Event

Arg me mateys! The great Pirate Hideout has been discovered in Dragon Saga!

There be a new event mission map in town, and it be for all level o' players beyond level 25, with monsters that scale to yer level! Run the Pirate's Hideout F1 Mission Map to obtain marvelous treasures in the form of mission rewards. 

Once ye have made it through the perilous gauntlet of Pirates and scallywags, at the end of this mission you will see two deadly bosses. One of them is the terrifying Hookah, but the other changes with the shifting sea! You will either face off with Alvida or Kalygon. Once you have battled these monstrous foes, they will drop grand pirate treasure chests! Be ye careful though, all monsters in the finale boss room will have to be killed to complete the map.

You may find inside this treasure chest a Slice of Cake, Yogurt, a Balloon, a treasure piece or, if ye be unlucky, junk! Don't worry though; you can always be selling the junk treasure for 10 silver to any shop NPC.

What about them glittery treasure pieces ye ask? The treasure pieces be needed to be exchanged to a Chucky's Clothing Gasha Box, which may be randomly yields a pirate clothing or th' mighty rare animated Moby Whale balloon. Where have you seen him before?

As fer them shiny mission end rewards, ye can get:

Repair Hammers
An EXP potion
Weapon Enchant Dust
Armor Enchant Dust
Souls
A Pirate's Weapon Gasha Box (only S~SSS Rank)
Pirate's Diamonds (only S~SSS Rank)

Ye can also trade 4 Golden Woodie Statues, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Woodie Statues at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Barter ye Booty' (level 25+). If ye be wanting to unlock this repeatable quest you have to complete Hookah's 'Enter th' Hideout' Quest (Level 25+) once on yer pirate fightin' character.

And if ye have some of them Pirate Diamonds, ye can trade 10 at a time at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Shiny Diamonds' (Level 25+) for a Big IM Consumable Gasha Box which randomly yields Event IM Consumables.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/4a5227eb85706008050175f2d1c6751398c9ed29.png[/img]
Maintenance Notes
Patch Version 0.9.30, Client Version: 10.4.2.16
Server Maintenance
2021-08-18, 13:00 Server Time

Unity Celebration
This event continues until August 25, 13:00 Server Time.

DragonSaga Evolved: Monster Defense Re-Design
We have re-designed the way how monster defense is working since it never has been adjusted to reflect current gameplay and stats.
So far monsters had a very low defense amount which has been designed for how the game worked in 2010 but it does not reflect the current high damage and stat amounts.
Instead of giving a flat defense amount, monsters now defend a specific amount of the damage which has been dealt to them with respect to the enchant level of the weapon and monster type. A field monster attacked with a +4 weapon doesn't have as much defense as a boss monster attacked with a +20 weapon. Due to the high difference in the damage amounts between a +4 and a +20 weapon it is still more efficient to use a +20 weapon to slay a boss monster than using a +4 weapon. Additionally this update makes the stat Critical Defense Break more useful in PvE.

Monsters below Level 20 have no defense.
Critical Defense Break Change
With this update also the Critical Defense Break Stat has been changed. Critical Defense Break can now happen if doing a normal hit as well with a chance of the Critical Defense Break Chance. 

For PvP nothing has changed.
 
New Monster Defense Percentage Sheet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/2087914643b65bfdca7b91be83b24466a8908680.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/31c78b938b8137761699f46aafa3c870f42ec250.png[/img]

 
 Calculation Examples
The monster defense is – as before – calculated per hit a player does to the monster. 

Example 1: 
Player hits an elite monster on a mission map with a +7 Weapon dealing 5,000 damage, having a Critical Def Break Amount of 30%. The monster has 9.31% defense.

Without a Critical Def Break hit:
FinalDamage = Damage – (Damage * MonsterDefense)
FinalDamage = 5000 – (5000 * 0.0931) = 5000 – 465 = 4535
The Damage a player deals to that kind of monster with a hit of 5,000 damage is 4,535.
With a Critical Def Break hit:
FinalDamage = Damage – (Damage * MonsterDefense * (1.0 – CriticalDefBreakAmount))
FinalDamage = 5000 – (5000 * 0.0931 * (1.0 – 0.3)) = 5000 – (5000 * 0.0931 * 0.7) =
		5000 – 325 = 4675
The Damage a player deals to that kind of monster with a hit of 5,000 damage as Critical Def Break hit with 30% amount is 4,675.

 Example 2: 
Player hits a boss monster on an Expert dungeon map with a +20 Weapon dealing 50,000 damage, having a Critical Def Break Amount of 60%. The monster has 30% defense.
Without a Critical Def Break hit:
FinalDamage = Damage – (Damage * MonsterDefense)
FinalDamage = 50000 – (50000 * 0.3) = 50000 – 15000 = 35000
The Damage a player deals to that kind of monster with a hit of 50,000 damage is 35,000.
With a Critical Def Break hit:
FinalDamage = Damage – (Damage * MonsterDefense * (1.0 – CriticalDefBreakAmount))
FinalDamage = 50000 – (50000 * 0.3 * (1.0 – 0.6)) = 50000 – (50000 * 0.3 * 0.4) =
		50000 – 6000 = 44000
The Damage a player deals to that kind of monster with a hit of 50,000 damage as Critical Def Break hit with 60% amount is 44,000.

DragonSaga Evolved: IM Weapons ATK/MATK
IM Weapons can now receive ATK/MATK (depending on the weapon type) stats when being soul crafted or soul craft randomized.

24 New Guild Emblems
We have added 24 new guild emblems to individualize your guild more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11261765/9b9cf5d92c4eda1bafbade084465bdf968693915.png[/img]
 

Starry, Protector, Undead Sheep, Scrappy, Infected Eye, Grumpy Bird
Ghosts Forbidden!, Lions, School of Sorcery, Jason the 13th, Holy Sword, Woodie Bag
Rush Hour, Cherry Blossom, Bone Vase, Black Union, Deadly Skull, Fire Guardian,
Water Guardian, Golden Chain, Midnight Wolves, Night Flyer, Resilient Eye, 3rd Eye
If you are the guild leader of a guild and you want to change your current emblem to a different one you can easily do that by obtaining the Guild Emblem Changer Item from the Item Mall (400 IM Points).

General Fixes and Changes 
- Fix: The Ice Quakee boss of the Ice Element Dungeon does no longer receive the Flinch effect for consistency with all other bosses
- Fix: The Burlune boss of the Nature Element Dungeon now takes his child monsters with it when it is dying

Change: CoD Mail Pickup Time
We have changed the time period in which you have to pickup the CoD Mail attachment before it is returned to the sender to 1 day. After 1 day the mail including the attachment is returned to the sender. Opening the mail does not increase the pickup time anymore.

Change: Pathfinder
We have fixed a bug in the pathfinder class skills. Some of the trap skills were able to be set up in air while they shouldn't. However, we have decided to keep the Freezing Trap and Splash Trap as is and adjusted the skill description to inform that dropping these traps is possible in air. The possibility of using Tesla Coil in air has been removed. We decided like this because we see no difference between the behavior of the different traps, while Tesla has a completely different behavior (for example running continously and being able to hit an enemy multiple times).

[b]Haven of Peace: Mood[/b]
Haven of Peace now supports the 4 moods Day, Night, Dusk and Dawn depending on your mood setting.

- QoL: To prevent item loss, boxes and chests cannot be opened on instanced Maps (Mission Maps, Dungeons, F6, F7) anymore.

- Fix: Fixed the monster skills Entangled Root and Net Bind. These skills did not affect the character's status at all (prevent character movement) but additionally caused a problem with characters which are able to change their form being stuck in that form if the form is changed while this status effect is active until they changed their form again. Now these skills do what they are supposed to do: Prevent characters from moving while this status effect is active.
- Fix: Nature Element Dungeon Fixed a bug causing that the Hero and advanced mode boss monsters had less HP than the normal mode boss monster.
- Fix: Ice Element Dungeon Fixed a bug causing that the Hero and advanced mode boss monsters had less HP than the normal mode boss monster.
- Fix: Fixed a bug that the attacks of Summons (Summoner), Pets and Twin's Twin were not affected by the weapon penalty.
- Fix: Fixed a bug that items from the Costume Inventory on page 2 can only be transferred to a free slot of the IM inventory on page 2 when trying to transfer the item by clicking the right mouse button.

WELCOME BACK EUROPE! 

Players of the World Unite... again! Event 

Nearly three years have passed since the DragonSaga players from Europe became Heroes in Exile but now they are finally returning. 

 

We thought this would be a great moment to dedicate a special event to every player on this server – to the ones staying with us for all this time and for the ones returning. 

The players of the world unite again and everyone is welcome, no matter from which country they come from.  

 

This is an event for everyone! 

For all Dragon Saga Players of the World! 

 

The Players of the World Unite again Event will last three weeks filled with different types of events: 

Grind Event, 2 Questchains, a special EXP Event, Enchant and Soulcraft Event, some surprises and hopefully a lot of fun! 

 

Questchain #1 

Player's of the World Unite (Level 20+) 

Start NPC is Pororing at the monument at Port of the Winds 

 

Questchain #2 

The World's Emblems (Level 25+) 

Start NPC is Pororing at the monument at Port of the Winds 

 

Hint: Every quest gives you a special item. You should keep them! 

 

 The 3 weeks this event is running are representing all the seasons to come in which we will play together again.Both questchains will reveal one new quest every few days as follows: 
 


Questchain #1: 

1st Quest "Fly like a Butterfly!" (Sprint) starts on May 12. 
2nd Quest "Like Ice in the Sunshine" (Summer) starts on May 18.  
3rd Quest "All the Leaves are Brown" (Fall) starts on May 23. 
4th Quest "Frosty the Snowming" (Winter) starts on May 28 
 
one of the 4 rewards is the Welcome Back Balloon. When this balloon is equipped on the IM or Costume Page, it changes the appearance of the chat bubble.

Questchain #2:

4th Quest "The World's Emblems (4)" starts on May 25.

For the 2nd questchain you need Books of Magic which are dropped by Monsters inside Expert Modes, Dungeons (except of Temple of Water) and Mission Maps starting with Mirinae Sanctuary.

The event runs until January 14, 13:00 Server Time.

Dragon Saga Evolved: Weapon Mutation System
Doctor Darrel has finally found out how to mutate weapons!
Mutate Weapon
With this system you are able to turn normal equip weapons  into costume weapons. To do that you need some materials which are: Broken Relics, Weapon Enchant Dust Cubes, one regular weapon and five [Normal] grade IM weapons part of which at least one needs to match your class. Additionally you need from the item mall: a Costume Mutator Item and if you want to protect your regular weapon you need to use a Mutation Insurance Scroll. The base success chance is 1%.

There are 3 types of Mutation Insurance Scrolls:
Mutation Insurance Scroll 
- protects the regular armor gear part from being destroyed on fail

Advanced Mutation Insurance Scroll 
- protects the regular weapon from being destroyed on fail
- protects 1 Weapon Enchant Dust Cube on fail
- increases the success chance to 3%
Reinforced Mutation Insurance Scroll 
- protects the regular weapon from being destroyed on fail
- protects 2 Weapon Enchant Dust Cubes on fail
- increases the success chance to 5%

[Normal] IM Weapons
You need to add at least one IM Weapon that matches your class. Any further added IM Weapon which is matching your class increases the success chance by 1%. Because of this you're able to reach a total success chance of 9% when using 5 IM Weapons matching your class and the Reinforced Mutation Insurance Scroll. If you don't want the bonus chance you can get by addings IM Weapons matching your class you can add any other IM weapon instead. 
Additionally if you add 5 IM weapons matching your class one less Weapon Enchant Dust Cube is needed.
Needed Materials
1x Regular Weapon Part
5x [Normal] grade IM weapon of which at least one needs to match your class, add more matching your class to get up to 4% success chance bonus, does not break on fail
1x Costume Mutator Item (Item Mall) – is not used up on fail
Weapon Enchant Dust Cube (the amount depends on the level of the Regular weapon, used up on each try)
[Optional] Mutation Insurance Scroll (see above)
5x Broken Relic (is used up on each attempt and cannot be protected)
 


 
Requirements...
... the regular weapon needs to be equipable by your own class tree
... the regular weapon needs to be Lv.20 or higher

If it fails...
... the Mutation Insurance Scroll is used up
... the Weapon Enchant Dust Cubes are used up (you can protect 1 or 2 by using the appropriate Mutation Insurance Scroll)
... the Broken Relics are used up
... the Regular weapon is destroyed if not protected by a Mutator Insurance Scroll
... the Costume Mutator Item isn't used up
... the IM Weapons are not destroyed

If  it succeeds...
... the Mutation Insurance Scroll is used up
... the needed Weapon Enchant Dust Cubes are used up 
... the Broken Relics are used up
... the Costume Mutator Item is used up
... the IM Weapons are used up
... the Regular Weapon is turned into a costume and moved to the Costume Inventory and will look like the regular weapon, the inventory icon has a small overlay to be identified as mutated costume

Parts with Soulcraft Effects, Enchants, Socket Cards, Soulcraft Effect Amplification, Soul Gems
All the effects on the weapons are gone. So make sure you only use items with effects you don't need or to Soul shift/Enchant shift/Socket extract/Soul Gem extract before mutating. You will get a warning message telling you what the parts have if needed.

Restrictions of Mutated Weapons
Mutated Weapons...
... have no stats
... can only be equipped on the costume page
... can not be sent by mail
... can not be sold in the open market
... can not be traded
... can not be put into any vault

Pirate's Hideout Event

Arg me mateys! The great Pirate Hideout has been discovered in Dragon Saga!

There be a new event mission map in town, and it be for all level o' players past level 25, with monsters that scale to yer level! Run the Pirate's Hideout F1 Mission Map to obtain marvelous treasures in the form of mission rewards. 

Once ye have made it through the perilous gauntlet of Pirates and scallywags, at the end of this mission you will see two deadly bosses. One of them is the terrifying Hookah, but the other changes with the shifting sea! You will either face off with Alvida or Kalygon . Once you have battled these monstrous foes, they will drop grand pirate treasure chests! Be ye careful though, all monsters in the finale boss room will have to be killed to complete the map.

You may find inside this treasure chest a Slice of Cake, Yogurt, a Balloon, a treasure piece or, if ye be unlucky, junk! Don't worry though; you can always be selling the junk treasure for 10 silver to any shop NPC.

What about them glittery treasure pieces ye ask? The treasure pieces be needed to be exchanged to a Chucky's Clothing Gasha Box, which may be randomly yields a pirate clothing or th' new 'n mighty rare Moby Whale balloon.
 

It's animated! Do you recognize him? Where have you seen him before?

As fer them shiny mission end rewards, ye can get:

Repair Hammers
An EXP potion
Weapon Enchant Dust
Armor Enchant Dust
Souls
A Pirate's Weapon Gasha Box (only S~SSS Rank)
Pirate's Diamonds (only S~SSS Rank)

Ye can also trade 4 Golden Woodie Statues, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Woodie Statues at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Barter ye Booty' (level 25+). If ye be wanting to unlock this repeatable quest you have to complete Hookah's 'Enter th' Hideout' Quest (Level 25+) once on yer pirate fightin' character.

And if ye have some of them Pirate Diamonds, ye can trade 10 at a time at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Shiny Diamonds' (Level 25+) for a Big IM Consumable Gasha Box which randomly yields IM Consumables.

So go get that pirate treasure, before the time is up, and those scurvy pirates sail back out to sea!

The event stays until October 8, 13:00 Server Time.
 

Dragon Saga Evolved
Changes to the Behavior of the Physical/Magic Damage Drop Stats
With this update the Physical/Magic Damage Drop formula has been reworked. The amount of damage drop is now soft capped at 10% permanent damage drop. Every amount above 10% is divided by 10 and added to the capped 10%. Therefore it is not possible to get more than 19% permanent damage drop.

Example:
The Fifth Hero Bracelet comes with 17% Damage Drop. The formula is calculated as follows:
10% of the 17% amount are the capped base amount you'll get as permanent damage drop. The remaining 7% are dived by 10 = 0.7% which is added to the 10% base amount you already have. Then you'll have a permanent damage drop of 10.7%.

Now you get your hands on Zeus Wing which give 10% magical damage drop. Your damage drop amount is now 27%. The calculation is now as follows:
10% of the 27% amount are the capped base amount you'll get as permanent magic damage drop. The remaining 17% are dived by 10 = 1.7% which is added to the 10% base amount you already have. Then you'll have a permanent magic damage drop of 11.7% and a permanent physical damage drop of 10.7%.

Additionally you always have a chance to get the full % damage drop amount you have on your gear on any hit. The chance to get that full amount is at 7.5% if you have a damage drop of 100%.
The formula for that calculation is as follow:
7.5% * ParticularDamageDrop / 100

Example for this Calculation:
Taken the above example with the bracelet and the wings, the chance you'll get the full drop amount when being hit is:

Physical: 7.5% * 17% / 100 = 1.28% - means you have a chance of 1.28% on a physical hit that the damage drops by 17% instead of only 10.7%
Magical: 7.5% * 27% / 100 = 2.03% - means you have a chance of 2.02% on a magic hit that the damage drops by 27% instead of only 11.7%

Now you can find an overview of the damage drop amounts you have at the character overview under the Defense category.



Party-Break In
The party-break in feature has been disabled for all instanced maps (Mission Maps, Dungeons).

MyHome
If you are a member in a party you now have to leave the party before you'll be able to enter a MyHome. That change was needed to fix several issues.

Maintenance Notes

Server Maintenance
2020-08-20, 13:00 Server Time



Bug Fixes: Debuffs from Skills
Several year's old bugs have been fixed which caused that monster kills weren't correctly counted (Kill Count, Quest Progress, Quest specific drops) in cases that the monster died from the damaged dealt by a debuff given by a particular skill instead of dying from the damage dealt by the skill itself (for example the Serious Burn debuff given by the Fire Orb). These bugs were not class specific. All skills giving debuffs of all classes were affected by it.

 

Bug Fix: Quick Quest List
Fixed a bug that caused a reset of the quest filter when the Quick Quest List for Hero Quests were opened (Red Exclamation Mark) before opening the Quick Quest List for Side Quests.

 

General Fixes
- Text fixes

 

Quality of Life: Moods
Ever wanted to know how a specific mood looks like but you never play at the particular time? Do you like the night moods more than any other mood? Now you have a way to select which mood you want.
At the options menu, Misc tab you'll find a new category Moods where you can set which mood you want or on which time it should be based

 


Change mood based on PC's time (default)
The mood is automatically changed at specific hours based on your PC's current time.

Change mood based on server time
The mood is automatically changed at specific hours based on the current server time.

Use day mood
Don't change moods automatically, instead always use the Day look of the map (the original look).

Use dusk mood
Don't change moods automatically, instead always use the Dusk look of a map if the map supports the dusk mood.

Use dark mood
Don't change moods automatically, instead always use the Dark look of a map if the map supports the dark mood.

Use dawn mood
Don't change moods automatically, instead always use the Dawn look of a map if the map supports the dawn mood.

The setting is saved locally for the whole client and not for the specific character.

 

Experimental: Fast Map Change
At the options menu, Misc tab you'll find a new category Experimental.
In the future there will be experimental options/features which are in beta state and need testing before the decision is made if they are released to the public or not – or if there are still bugs to be fixed. You will be able to opt-out these options if the option degrades your gaming experience or you encounter any issues with it (for example: increased amount of client crashes).

The first option you can find here is: Fast Map Change.
If checked an experimental feature is used which should significantly reduce the time a map needs to switch (reduces the delay between map change and loading bar).
Since the feature is experimental you may encounter issues, like an unusual increase of crashes during map changes and other issues when this option is enabled. If that is the case it's recommended to turn the feature off. The option is enabled by default.


 

Blizzard Ridge: Mood
Blizzard now supports the 4 moods Day, Night, Dusk and Dawn depending on your mood setting.

The Party Buff system has been completely reworked. It is no longer class based instead it is based on party size and the party member level.

[b]Enchant/Soulcraft Success Chance Event[/b]
The Enchant and Soulcraft Success Chance Event has been extended until the end of the Summer Event. The [u]Scroll down... a bit[/u] event has ended and the quest has been [b]removed.[/b]

 

[b]Quality of Life: UI Improvements[/b]

[b]Inventory Level Indicator[/b]
Did you ever face the situation that you were running the Destiny Dungeon for hours and forgot to check if your inventories are full and so you got the annoying temporary inventory or missed dropped items? We did. Often. Too often.
So we had the idea to add the new Inventory Level Indicator to the game.


You can find it below the repair/penalty indicator "man".
The indicator shows you the current state of your 4 main inventories (from left to right): Equip, Cons, Misc, IM. The icons are "color coded" to show you quickly what the current state is:
Red: the particular inventory has only 8 or less free slots left.
Yellow: the particular inventory has 50% or less free space left.
Green: the particular inventory has more than 50% free space left.

Below the icons a number shows the remaining free slots of the particular inventory. If an inventory is completely full that number turns into the text "FULL" written in red.

The Inventory Level Indicator can be configured in the options menu:

 


Show all indicators: All 3 colors of the different states are shown: Red, Yellow and Green
Show only yellow and red indicators: It does what it says, it only shows Red and Yellow indicators
Show only ref indicators: This does what it says as well, it only shows Red indicators.
Hide indicators: Completely turns off the indicator feature
Hide number of free empty slots: Turns off that the numbers of free slots are shown

 

 

[b]Costume Inventory[/b]
The costume inventory is that bad thing that makes your costume parts disappear when you unequip them from the costume page. It's no mythos, it exists. If you're one of it's victims or you still can't find it you could simply press "T" (default key binding) or right-click on the Inventory Bag item to open the Costume Inventory page. OR ... you can use the brand new amazing button we added to the main inventory window to open the Costume Inventory from there.


Here is the proof that the Costume Inventory never was a hoax. It actually exists. Try the button and look at the Costume Inventory. You might find things you thought you lost.

- an issue with the friendlist has been fixed. It should now be working correctly
- an issue has been fixed that the Soul Force Capsule did not show the saved options for some item types

[b]Guild Levels[/b]
2 new guild levels have been added, guild level 7 and 8.
To reach guild level 7 you need 200,000 guild EXP. A level 7 guild can have 175 members and can buy the skill Iron Wall Lv.2 (DEF and MDEF increased by 15% of the character base amount).
To reach guild level 8 you need 320,000 guild EXP. A level 8 guild can have 200 members and can buy the skill Morale Up Lv.2 (ATK and MATK increased by 10% of the character base amount).
 

[b]Calculation Formula Adjustments[/b]
[b]Changed calculation formulas for Character Base (Default) ATK and DEF.[/b]

[b][u]PATK[/u][/b]
Old[u]: STR_up * 1.5 + HLT_up / 6[/u]
New: [u](STR_up * 1.5 + HLT_up / 6) * (1 + AGI_up / 500)[/u]

[b][u]MATK[/u][/b]
Old[u]: log10(INT_up) * INT_up[/u]
New: [u]log10(INT_up) * INT_up * (1 + AGI_up / 600)[/u]
 


[b][u]PDEF[/u][/b]
Old[u]: STR_up * 0.8 + HLT_up * 0.4 + AGI_up * 0.2[/u]
New: [u]STR_up * 1.0 + HLT_up * 0.4 + AGI_up * 0.75[/u]

[b][u]MDEF[/u][/b]
Old[u]: (INT_up * 1.2 + INT_up * PlayerLevel / 100) * 2[/u]
New: [u](INT_up * 1.2 + INT_up * PlayerLevel / 100) * 2 + AGI_up * 0.3[/u]

This results in AGI having more influence on ATK and DEF amounts generally and STR has a bit more influence on PDEF.

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/16/2020
notes.notes:
Maintenance Notes
Patch Version 0.8.29, Client Version: 10.4.0.0
Server Maintenance
2020-04-16, 13:00 Server Time


DragonSaga Evolved Update
This update contains breaking changes to the game and the game mechanics. The goal of the update is to balance the game, close a gap between op and non-op classes, give the possibility of more diversity  and make the game more enjoyable again. 

Stat Changes
The stats Aim Rate, Evade Rate, Block Rate and Block Damage have been removed.
The following 9 new stats have been introduced:
Critical Damage Reduction Amount and Chance
With Critical Damage Reduction the player has the possibility to counter an enemy's critical attack. When the effect is applied only the critical damage of the attacker is reduced by the Critical Damage Reduction Amount of the target. The base damage of the attack stays untouched. How often the effect appears is based on the Critical Damage Reduction Chance.
Example:
An attacker attacks with 5000 Damage and deals a critical hit with 300% Critical Damage, which means 15000 Damage in total, the target has built a Critical Damage Reduction Amount of 25%. The portion the critical damage has on the total Damage is reduced by 25%. In this example the 10000 Critical Damage dealt is reduced by 25%, which means that the total damage the attacker will deal after the reduction is 12500 (5000 Base Damage + 7500 Critical Damage).
Final Damage Reduction Amount and Chance
With Final Damage Reduction the player has the possibility to reduce the attackers final damage when hit. This includes the Element Damage the attacker deals. The Final Damage is reduced by the built Final Damage Reduction Amount. How often it happens is based on the Final Reduction Chance.
Important! A Final Damage Reduction can only appear if the attack was not critical.
The Damage of the attacker will always be 1 damage even if the amount is built to 100%.

Critical Defense Break Chance and Amount
With Critical Defense Break the player is able to break the enemy's defense when attacking. It can only appear if the hit was a critical hit. Every critical hit has a chance of the built Critical Defense Break Chance to become a critical defense break hit. The defense amount of the target is broken by the built amount of Critical Defense Break Amount.
X-Attack Damage Reduction
This stat is only useful for PvP since attacks of monsters are never considered as X-Attack. The X-Attack reduces the damage an enemy player deals when using a skill which is considered as X-Attack. The damage is reduced by the amount of the built X-Attack Damage Reduction but it does not affect the Element Damage the attacker deals.
Following skills are considered as X-Attack:
Destroyer Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)
Random Shot
Two Action Shot
Shootdown

Sentinel Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)

Ninja Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)
Ninja-Form X-Combo 

Gambit Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)

Dragoon Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)

Overlord Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)

Twin
Main X-Combo (new and old)

Summoner
Main X-Combo (new and old)

Sorcerer Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)



Invoker Class Path
Main X-Combo (new and old)
Diffusion Cannon
Double Shot
Chain Lightning
Cooldown Time Reduction
When building this stat the cooldown time of several (but not all) skills can be reduced. Skills now have a fixed and a variable cooldown. The variable cooldown can be reduced by the stat or the cooldown reduction skill (Time Reverse Aura). The fixed portion of the cooldown time cannot be lowered.
100% Cooldown Time Reduction means that the whole variable cooldown can be reduced to zero. If the cooldown time reduction is built to 50% only the half of the variable cooldown is reduced.
Cast Time Reduction
Works the same as the cooldown reduction but for Cast Time. 
Caps
The new stats are capped at the following amounts:
Critical Damage Reduction Amount 75%
Critical Damage Reduction Chance 25%
Final Damage Reduction Amount 100%
Final Damage Reduction Chance 15%
Critical Defense Break Amount 80%
Critical Defense Break Chance 15%
X-Attack Damage Reduction 60%
Cooldown Reduction 100%
Cast Time Reduction 100%

Details for the new stats can bee seen in the character overview:
 

All stats can be soulcrafted but not all types of items can get all stats. In the list below you can find which stat can be crafted on what item.
 
Soulcrafting Ranges:
Crit. Dmg. Reduction Amount: 1.2%, 1.5%, 2.0%, 3.0%, 6.0%
Crit. Dmg. Reduction Chance: 0.5%, 0.7%, 0.9%, 1.2%, 2.5%
Final Dmg. Reduction Amount: 1.5%, 2.0%, 3.0%, 4.0%, 8.0%
Final Dmg. Reduction Chance: 0.3%, 0.4%, 0.5%, 0.8%, 1.5%
Crit. Def Break Amount: 1.5%, 2.0%, 3.0%, 4.0%, 8.0%
Crit. Def Break Chance: 0.3%, 0.4%, 0.5%, 0.8%, 1.5%
X-Attack Reduction: 1.5%, 2.0%, 3.0%, 4.0%, 7.0%
Cooldown Time Reduction: 3.0%, 4.0%, 6.0%, 9.0%, 17.0%
Cast Time Reduction: 3.0%, 4.0%, 6.0%, 9.0%, 17.0%

Free Randomizing of Aim, Evade and Block Stats
At the Vending Machine you can get an [Evolution] Soul Craft Randomizer for 1 Silver Coin which only randomizes the now useless stats. You only need one to randomize all useless stats at once.

 
Equipment Penalty
If equipment lower with a difference of 15+ levels to the player level is equipped a penalty for that is given. The status of a specific gear part can be seen at that indicator:
 
The colors are defined as follows:
Yellow – the gear level is 15+ below the player level but still has less or equal 50% of penalty.
Orange – the gear has a penalty higher than 50% (that starts to happen at around 21 levels below the character level).
Purple – the gear has a penalty of 100% (that happens usually at around 30 levels below the character level) or the item is not equipped.
Weapon Penalty
The penalty on a weapon is the flat penalty on the final damage. At 100% Penalty the weapon still deals 1 damage.
 
Gear Penalty
The gear penalty is calculated from the average penalties of the following gear parts: Helmet, Top, Bottom, Shoes and Gloves. Shoulders can reduce the penalty if their level is in the range of 0 to 14 levels below the player but never can increase the penalty – even not if they are not equipped or 30 levels below. The shoulder status is not shown in the indicator. The back item is not taken into account.
IM items are not taken into account for the penalty calculation.
Your current penalty can be seen when hovering over the penalty indicator with the mouse pointer. The tooltip shows detailed information on the current penalty:
 
Note: You can turn off the penalty indicator in the option at the misc tab:
 

 
Changes to Monsters
General Changes
- the Monster HP of all Monsters has been increased except for the Destiny Dungeon bosses
- the Monster Damage has been increased except for the Destiny Dungeon bosses

Monsters have Stats!
The monsters can have the same new stats which have been added for the player excluding the time reductions.
Normal Monsters have a varying X-Atk Reduction, Critical Damage of 300% with a chance of 25%, Critical Damage Reduction of 30% with a chance of 30%, Final Damage Reduction of 30% with a chance of 15% and no Critical Def Break.
Upgraded Monsters have a varying X-Atk Reduction, Critical Damage of 250% with a chance of 33%, Critical Damage Reduction of 40% with a chance of 30%, Final Damage Reduction of 50% with a chance of 20% and no Critical Def Break.
Elite Monsters (Minibosses, Mission Map Bosses) and Boss Monsters have varying stats which can be seen at the new indicators below their health bar:
 
 
CD = Critical Damage
CDR = Critical Damage Reduction
FDR = Final Damage Reduction
CBR = Critical Defense Break
XAR = X-Attack Reduction

C = Chance, A = Amount, R = Ranged, M = Melee
 
Monsters with yellow HP Bars
Monsters having yellow HP bars cannot be damaged by attacks considered X-Attack. They spawn randomly and cannot be predicted.
  
Free Skill Reset Scrolls
You can get 3 free Skill Reset Scrolls by doing the Quest at NPC Gato at Port of the Winds.
This offer expires on April 23 13:00 Server Time.

Evolution Event
Monsters inside Expert Modes, Dungeons and Mission Maps starting with Mirinae Sanctuary are dropping Double Helix. You can collect them and trade them at the Vending Machine for a part of the [Event] Evolution Set oder the Evolution Accessory Set.
The event runs until April 30 13:00 Server Time.

Enchant and Soulcraft Event
Until April 23, 13:00 Server Time Enchant and Soulcraft success chances are doubled.

[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]

 

Patch Version 0.8.4, Client Version: 10.3.3.16

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]

12-5-2019, 13:00 Server Time

 

[b]Vyvern Lounge[/b]

[b]News Board[/b]
You will now be notified by a symbol on the minimap if new messages on the News Board at the Vyvern Lounge are available. The symbol is flashing in red when a new "hot message" is available, it flashes in purple when new "normal" messages are available.
If you are inside the Vyvern Lounge the News Board gets a symbol above it (same color scheme as the flashing icon on the minimap) if new messages are available.

When looking at the news board unread messages are having a green symbol on the right side to inidicate that these are unread.

[b]X-Mas decoration[/b]
The Vyvern Lounge is now full of christmas spirit.

[b]X-Mas Event 2019[/b]
This years X-Mas Event will bring you back the X-Mas Mission Map. The event lasts until January, 2nd.

 

[b]X-Mas Event Mission Map[/b]
The X-Mas Mission Map consist of Arcade (F1) Mode, Chaos (F2) Mode and two Scenario Modes (F5). The first Scenario Mode is for the initial questline and the second one is for the daily quest.

[u]Possible mission rewards are:[/u]

 

[u]Arcade (F1) Mode:[/u]
Armor Enchant Dust
Weapon Enchant Dust
Souls
EXP Double Up Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins.)
X-Mas Ballon Box (contains different balloons only)
X-Mas Accessory Box (contains different X-Mas accessories like the Carrot Nose)
X-Mas Santa Costume Box (contains Santa Costume in Pink, Red, Green and White)
X-Mas Jewelry Box (Advanced Grade) (contains Christmas Skill Accessories)
X-Mas Furniture Box (Arcade) (contains different MyHome furniture)
Frost Weapon Box (contains Frost Weapons – former the IM Ice Weapons, the weapons have been renamed to not collide with the element Ice Weapons name wise)
[u]Chaos (F2) Mode:[/u]
Armor Enchant Dust
Weapon Enchant Dust
Souls

X-Mas Ballon Box (contains different balloons only)

X-Mas Furniture Box (Chaos) (contains different MyHome furniture)
Magical Ice Weapon Box (contains Magical Ice Weapons)

Besides this all boss monsters drop Christmas cookies (food for HP/MP regeneration)

 

[b]Main Questline[/b]
After completing 3 quests you will be able to run F5 Scenario Mode daily to obtain 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can be exchanged for a X-Mas Costume Box.

 

[b]The 12 Quests of Christmas[/b]
Beginning with December, 14th you will get a new quest of the quest collection "The 12 Quests of Christmas" daily until December, 25th. The "job" for each of these quests is all around the X-Mas Event Mission Map. The quests can be done until 12/31, 23:59 Server Time. Every quest gives you 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can be exchanged for a winter themed car mount (Winter Rover) or a winter themed sheep mount (Frosty Flix). Also you will get a brand new X-Mas achievement.

[u]Please notice that the car/sheep is neither tradable/sellable nor account vaultable. Since the x-mas quests are beginning with Lvl. 20 we needed to restrict the eggs too to prevent abuse.[/u]

[b]Drop Event
Collect [/b][u][b]Santa Christmas Boxes (2019)[/b][/u][b] which need to be opened with [/b][u][b]Santa Key (2019).[/b] [/u]The key can be obtained by exchanging it for [u]Burned Cookies [/u](see below).
The box randomly gives you one of the following:

[u]1x Christmas Stocking – contains a part of the new [Event] Yule Costume

1x X-Mas Accessory Box

200x Soul

When it snows in the lands of Dragon Saga you can have the chance to get a 10 minute EXP bonus randomly between 1.1x ~ 1.5x.

 

*This EXP Bonus applies to Channel 4 as well because it is a buff. If you don't need the bonus EXP it can be cancelled by right clicking on the buff icon in the upper left corner.

[b]Vyvern Lounge[/b]
We are proud to introduce a place where you can hang out and chill. And besides this you can gather information or buy some instant HP/MP restoring food items.

Rudolph has decided to open a lounge at Port of the Winds West  If you go there you will notice a new entrance. Press 'Z' to ender when standing in front of it.

 

[b]Instant HP/MP Restoring Food Items[/b]
NPC Tiffany, the bar tender of the Vyvern Lounge will sell a variety of food items to restore HP and MP instantly. Just talk to her to see what she has to offer. But be aware that the food items are level limited. However, if you bought too much you can sell the leftovers to any shop NPC for the same price you bought them.

 

[b]Server Clock[/b]
When hanging around inside the Vyvern Lounge you will never get confused with timezones because you will see the server date and time right on the wall of the Vyvern Lounge. Additionally the Server Clock shows the current EXP rate on the particular channel.

 

[b]Maintenance Timer[/b]
On the opposite side of the Vyvern Lounge there is another clock, but this one is a countdown clock which shows you how many time is left until the next regular server maintenance starts. It changes it's colors the closer the maintenance time is.

 

[b]Mail [/b]
At the mailbox you can grab your mail or send mail. With this Vyvern Lounge Update all mailboxes at all cities only show the letter above them if you have unread mail.

Inside the Vyvern Lounge you can open the Market window and you also get resting exp.

You can get a quest to introduce the Vyvern Lounge at NPC Sofia.

The second part is split into 2 parts. With this maintenance the first part will be implemented.
This update will enable some additional features. To access these features you need one of the following items placed into your MyHome:

Following new features have been implemented:

Filters
If a closet is placed into your MyHome the tabs at the top of the Costume Inventory are enabled. These filters allow you see only specific parts of the costumes (like tops, gloves, shoes, etc.) inside the Costume Inventory. By left clicking on the tabs the filer is activated. You can specify more than one filter at the same time. By clicking with the right mouse button on one of the tabs the filter clicked on will be activated and all other filters are removed. If you want to see your complete inventory again you can either disable filters by clicking on them to deactivate the selected ones or by clicking on the "Reset Filters" button below the inventory.


Select and Equip
If you hold down the left SHIFT key while clicking on a costume part you can select it. You are able to select one of each costume part (e.g. a top, a bottom,  a balloon, a weapon) and equip them all at once by clicking on the "Equip selected" button below the inventory.

If you want to deselect all selected items you can click on the "Clear Selection" button.

You can only select one of each costume part. If you make selections while you also selected filters, the items will stay selected when changing filters or when returning to the complete inventory view.

After equipping the selected items the selection is cleared.
By default the costume will be equipped as the costume of your character. If you open the character overview and select the IM page the selected costume will be equipped as IM gear.

 

Outlook on the upcoming features
The next part of this 2nd update will give you the opportunity to create a user-defined costume set and name it and then it can be equipped with only one click on the button.  Also this feature will be only available if a closet is placed in your MyHome.

Exchanging the Hero Sign of Odellia directly to the Elemental Sign of Odellia costs 75 Every element blesses, 30 Purification Stones and 20 Weapon Enchant Dust Cubes.

When you move items to the vault by clicking with the right mouse button the items are now put into the currently selected page of the vault. We have added a bunch of new Support Pets this week. All of them are capable to reach max stats and to get MS and AS (but not both together). Also they all share the Teleport skill and the Teleport Cost Reduction Skill.

Summer is here and the temperature is rising. What could be better than going to the beach, jumping into the cool water and enjoying the summer sun, looking at all the palm tress while having a cool Pineapple Drink and listening to some Reggae Music? The full Jamaica feeling hits Port of the Winds – the whole day – and from dusk til dawn. But the summer in Dragon Saga is more than just being lazy! Fight monsters and get some nice event stuff! Take your gear and help the small baby dragon Yongha out with his problem at the Summer Wave Coast. A lot of nice stuff is awaiting you.
 
When entering Summer Wave Coast an instanced map with end reward boxes is ready for you. The map can be entered starting with Level 25.
