[b]Valentine's Day Event 2019 – Event Guide[/b]
 

[b]Cookie Factory is back![/b]
Stop Derek from kidnapping children and poisoning sweets and candies.

 

[b]Chocolate Meister's House and Chocolate Storage[/b]
Open the doors to Chocolate Meister's House and the Chocolate Storage by playing the initial questline. It starts at NPC Floran at Port of the Winds. The quest will show up for all players Level 20+.

 

[b]Chocolate Meister's House (Event Map F6 Mode)[/b]
To access this mode you need to have Tickets to Chocolate Meister's House (F6) [2016] in your inventory. They're working like the defense orders. One is needed for a party size up to 2 players and two tickets are needed for parties of 3 and 4 players. The tickets can be obtained from the initial questline and as a world drop (by killing any monster).

No Perfect Hunches are needed to get the directions guessing rewards. Instead you will need Magical Flower Bouquets. You can obtain Magical Flower Boxes containing up to 3 Magical Flower Bouquets by killing monsters on any hidden (scroll) map. Those hidden scrolls are dropped by any boss of the regular mission maps. Hidden maps are available for all level ranges. When you are asked to guess the monster direction you can use the Magical Flower Bouquet to always have a right guess.



[u]5 Valentine Silver Coins [/u]can be traded at NPC Gordon in Port of the Winds to obtain a [u]Valentine's Silver Accessory Box. [/u]This box can contain a part of the Lovely Silver Accessory Set or a Valentine's Day consumable item.

 

You can trade in 2 specific parts of the Lovely Silver Accessory Set to get one Lovey Gold Accessory Set part at NPC Gordon.

[u]15 Valentine Gold Coins[/u] can be traded at NPC Gordon for a Big IM Consumables Box.
[u]10 Valentine Gold Coins[/u] can be traded at NPC Gordon for a Cupid Box. This box randomly contains a part of the Cupid Set
[u]20 Valentine Gold Coins[/u] can be traded at NPC Gordon for an [Event] Styling Pink Box. This box randomly contains a part of the [Event] Styling Pink Set.

[b]Please know that all boxes are fully restricted.[/b]

 

At Stage 5 and Stage 10 you get a stage end reward similar to the mission result rewards. You will get 4 random rewards out of the following:
[list][*]Money Bag Gasha Box containing a gold bag with a random amount of gold[/*][*]Armor Enchant Dust Gift Box (4 ea)[/*][*]Weapon Enchant Dust Gift Box (2 ea)[/*][*]Soul Gift Box (14 ea)[/*][*]Valentine Balloon Box containing a random Valetine's Day Balloon[/*][*]Valentine Accessory Box containing a random Valentine's Day Costume Accessory[/*][*]EXP Double Up potion (10 mins)[/*][/list]
[b]Chocolate Storage (Event Map F1 Mode)[/b]
During the questline you will be send into the F1 Mode several times.

As end reward you get the following:

The Sweets Ingredients Box obtainable in the Chocolate Meister's House (F6) mode contains 2 of each of the Cookie Recipie ingredients: Flour, Almond, Marshmellow, Stick, Chocolate, Butter, Milk, Powder Sugar, and 5 Valentine Recipe Boxes

[b]Valentine Recipe Box[/b]
The recipe box can be obtained from the F1 Mode and is given by Cookie Ingredient Boxes.

 

[b]Couple Questline[/b]
When playing as a couple or married couple and after completing the quest "Proof of Love" you will be able to start a questline especially for couples to obtain parts of this year's valentine's day event costume set. For finishing the last quest of this quest line you will get the Valentine's Day achievement (Be my Valentine), 2 Love Message Cards, 5 Love Love Warps and a Valentine's Pet Gift Coupon. With this coupon you can get one of three Valentine Pets:
[list][*]Ms. Gingerbread[/*][*]ChocoChop[/*][*]Lovely Woodie[/*][/list]
All three pets are ordinary pets at level 20 and need normal Pet Food to be kept alive. You can sell the pet eggs in the open-market, but once the pet egg is opened the pet itself is fully restricted.

Maintenance Notes

Server Maintenance
2019-01-30, 12:00 Server Time

[b]
Dragon Crush Accessory Grind Event[/b]
The grind is real, Dragon Saga Friends! Go and get Silver Coins, Gada Coins and Red Horned Dragon Skulls to exchange them for Dragon Crush Accessory parts at the Vending Machine.
Every part needs 100 Silver Coins and 50 Red Horned Dragon Skulls! Enjoy the grinding and good luck!
 

The event has been extended until February, 6th 12:00 Server Time.

 

[b]Groundhog Day Mini Event[/b]

On February, 2nd is Groundhog Day. This is a great opportunity to have a Groundhog Day Mini Event. Continue killing monsters and get more Red Horned Dragon Skulls and grab yourself a Groundhog Balloon and a Groundhog Hat (50 Silver Coins and 20 Red Horned Dragon Skulls each).

This event runs until February, 6th 12:00 Server Time.



[b]Dungeon of Destiny[/b]

Within the Dungeon of Destiny the cooldown of Diffusion Cannon, Double Shot and Helix Shot have been removed to workaround the issue with the disappearing buff effect some players experience after a map change within the Dungeon. This workaround will be removed as soon as we addressed the issue causing this behavior. Since we are not able to reproduce the issue easily we decided to implement this workaround for the time being.


[b]Port of the Winds Moods[/b]

Depending on your PCs time you will now see Port of the Winds in different moods: Dusk, Night, Dawn, Daylight of the particular season (Winter or Summer).
Please know that due to technical limitations the mood is only able to change after a map change.

The particular mood can be seen during the following times*:

Winter: Dawn 7:00-9:59, Daylight 10:00-16:59, Dusk 17:00-19:59, Night 20:00-6:59
Summer: Dawn 5:00-7:59, Daylight 8:00-19:59, Dusk 20:00-22:59, Night 23:00-4:59

* all times are local times (the current time of the PC the game is running on), while the season is server controlled. During Halloween and Christmas theme no mood changes happen

 

Perimeter-B Mission Maps

The Perimeter-B mission maps have been polished up a bit to make them look better.

[b]General Fixes and Changes[/b]

- Map changing times have been significantly reduced – this is especially noticeable when changing from Arcadia City to a different map. This fix is experimental. If you now experience an increased amount of client crashes during map changes please let us know through the usual channels (Forum, Ticket, Unofficial Dragon Saga Discord).

- the balloons in the Vending Machine have been replaced. The new balloons you can obtain for 10 Silver Coins each (as usual) are: Doll Balloon and the Groundhog in a wheel balloon.

Events
 

[b]Talk like a Pirate! Day Event
[u]"[/u][/b][u]Why are pirates pirates? cuz they arrrrrr"[/u]

[u]Pirate's Hideout Event[/u]

[u]Arg me mateys! The great Pirate Hideout has been discovered in Dragon Saga!

There be a new event mission map in town, and it be for all level o' players past level 25, with monsters that scale to yer level! Run the Pirate's Hideout F1 Mission Map to obtain marvelous treasures in the form of mission rewards. 

Once ye have made it through the perilous gauntlet of Pirates and scallywags, at the end of this mission you will see two deadly bosses. One of them is the terrifying Hookah, but the other changes with the shifting sea! You will either face off with Alvida or Kalygon . Once you have battled these monstrous foes, they will drop grand pirate treasure chests! Be ye careful though, all monsters in the finale boss room will have to be killed to complete the map.

You may find inside this treasure chest a Slice of Cake, Yogurt, a Balloon, a treasure piece or, if ye be unlucky, junk! Don't worry though; you can always be selling the junk treasure for 10 silver to any shop NPC.

What about them glittery treasure pieces ye ask? The treasure pieces be needed to be exchanged to a Chucky's Clothing Gasha Box, which may be randomly yields a pirate clothing!

As fer them shiny mission end rewards, ye can get:

Repair Hammers
An EXP potion
Weapon Enchant Dust
Armor Enchant Dust
Souls
A Pirate's Weapon Gasha Box (only S~SSS Rank)
Pirate's Diamonds (only S~SSS Rank)

Ye can also trade 4 Golden Woodie Statues, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Woodie Statues at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Barter ye Booty' (level 25+). If ye be wanting to unlock this repeatable quest you have to complete Hookah's 'Enter th' Hideout' Quest (Level 25+) once on yer pirate fightin' character.

And if ye have some of them Pirate Diamonds, ye can trade 5 at a time at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Shiny Diamonds' (Level 25+) for a Big IM Consumable Gasha Box which randomly yields IM Consumables.

So go get that pirate treasure, before the time is up, and those scurvy pirates sail back out to sea![/u]

[b]The event stays until October, 3<sup>rd</sup> 12:00 Server Time.[/b]

 
Changes
 

[b]Quest EXP Adjustments[/b]
The EXP given by Hero and Side Quests in the level range 41 to 50 has been significantly increased.

 

[b]General Fixes and Changes[/b]
- added [u]This is Mine![/u] Skill to [u]Griffon Mount[/u]
- fixed the inventory icons of the [Hero] 5<sup>th</sup> Hero Gunstaff
- several text fixes

 

[b]Destiny Forged Weapons (Item Mall)[/b]
The Destiny Forged Weapons Gasha Box has been added to the Item Mall (100 IM points each). These all new weapons have been forged from Destiny's Scale. They come with Attack Speed +10%, Movement Speed +15% and Health +10. These weapons are heavy! This is why you need to be at least level 20 to equip them. The weapons can be equiped on the Item Mall or Costume Weapon Slot ([u]by equipping them on the Costume Weapon Slot you'll get the look but not the stats).[/u] Every box yields one Destiny Forged Weapon for a random class.



[b]Crazy Johnny's Pirate Weapons (Item Mall)[/b]
Just in time for the [u]Talk Like a Pirate[/u] Event crazy shark Johnny comes around with lots of boxes filled with pirate weapons! Grab yours from the Item Mall and buy a box from him (100 IM points each). These weapons are so dangerous and... old... that only an experienced player who has reached Level 20 can equip it! The weapons can be equipped on the Item Mall or Costume Weapon Slot ([u]by equipping them on the Costume Weapon Slot you'll get the look but not the stats).[/u] Every box yields one Crazy Johnny Weapon for a random class.

notes.notes:
Patch Notes
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.6.86, Client Version: 10.3.1.0
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2018-09-05, 12:00 Server Time

 

Events

 

[b]Galaxia Support Box Drop Event [/b]
This event is ending.

 

[b]Sweets Ingredients Box Drop Event[/b]
This event is ending.

 
[b]Significant Changes to the Game[/b]

 

[b]F7 Modes[/b]
- to enter the F7 mode every party member has to have the quest [u]Official Appointment [/u]and the Scenario (F5) quest of the particular Mission Map completed to be able to participate in the F7 mode

- all monster's base EXP in F7 mode is halved

- if 3 or more party members are participating in F7 together the big [u]Bonus Bombers' [/u]HP is doubled

- players are not longer able to obtain event world drops (including [u]Silver Coins[/u]) on any F7 ground

- the attack increasing skill which can be obtained from the NPC inside F7 has been changed to only have 3 levels instead of 4

 

 

[b]Hero Quests![/b]
All Hero Quests (the ones with red exclamation mark) are now chained together in some way. This means, to be able to complete the Scenario Mode (F5) of any Mission Map it is needed to meet new quest requirements first.

  

[b]The level requirement for the Quest [u]To Ash Mist [/u]has been changed from Lv. 60 to 53.[/b]

 

[b]Dungeons[/b]

To participate in a Dungeon all party members need to meet specific requirements first to enter the Dungeon. 

[b][u]It is recommended to complete all Hero Quests to get full game experience and to make sure that no requirement is left undone.[/u][/b]

 

[b]Galaxia Dungeon[/b]
[b]Several changes have been made to the Galaxia Dungeon.[/b]

- on Saturday and Sunday [u]all[/u] dungeons are accessible

- the quest to get the Star Stones appear on their particular weekday as well as on Saturday and Sunday

- the quest to get the entry items appear on their particular weekday as well as on Saturday and Sunday

- the dependency on the Black Dragon Lord's gear to forge the Protector of Stars gear (including weapon) has been removed

- after finishing the Galaxia questline (Quest: [u]In search if Pios[/u]) and completing the Quest [u]Top of Drakos[/u] the Quest [u]Protector of Stars[/u] automatically appears. After completion of [u]Protector of Stars[/u] all materials to forge Protector of Stars gear and weapon can be obtained from Crete

 


[b]General Changes[/b]
- the initial quest of the Akanai quest chain has been renamed from [u]Kill Akanai![/u] to [u]Prepare yourself to kill Akanai![/u] to prevent confusion

- the Lavalon [u]Seal Remover Key[/u] (which is obtained from [u]Rokko[/u] inside the [u]Magma Dungeon[/u]) has been made tradeable in case that another party member accidentally gets the key instead of the party leader

 

[b]Soul Gems[/b]
A new Soul Smith arrived in town. Welcome [u]Dark Soul Smith Baron[/u] to Port of the Winds.
When talking to him a new menu [u]Craft Soul Gem[/u] is available.

 

[b]How are Soul Gems used?[/b]
There are 5 different Soul Gems available. Each of them is representing one of the five heroes: Skypie, Mirinae, Parmir, Belkan and the 5<sup>th</sup> hero.

The following weapons are able to hold these Soul Gems:

 

Dark Soul Weapon
[Best] Dark Soul Weapon
Fire Weapon
Ice Weapon
Nature Weapon
Dark Weapon
Magma Lord Weapon
Magichenge Weapon
Undead Bone Weapon
Element Bone Weapon
Zauharant Weapon
Black Dragon Lord Weapon
Black Dragon Lord Element Weapon
[Rare] Protector of Stars Weapon
[Hero] Protector of Start Weapon
[Advanced] 5<sup>th</sup> Hero Weapon
[Hero] 5<sup>th</sup> Hero Weapon

 
 

Each Soul Gem can be inserted once into one of these weapons. A weapon can hold all 5 different Soul Gems.



[b]Important! [/b][u]Soul Gems can only inserted into a weapon that is either soulbound (for example Zauharant Weapons) or account bound (for example Magma Lord Weapon).[/u]

[u]Inserted Soul Gems can't be removed (however, we will introduce an IM Soul Gem Extractor soon).[/u]

 

[b]What is the purpose of Soul Gems?[/b]
Inserting Soul Gems reduces the difference between the minimum and maximum Attack Value of the particular weapon by a specific percentage which is class dependent.


 

[b]How do I obtain Soul Gems?[/b]
You can craft Soul Gems at [u]NPC Baron[/u]. The base material needed to craft a Soul Gems is [u]Devil's Soul Stones[/u]. You can obtain those by killing monsters in any available hidden map.

 

[b]Soul Gem crafting[/b]
The first Soul Gem (Skypie's Soul Gem) needs 150 [u]Devil's Soul Stones [/u]to be forged. The success chance for the first Soul Gem is always 100% and does not cost any gold.

 

 

The second Soul Gem (Mirinae's Soul Gem) needs [u]200 Devil's Soul Stones[/u] and one Skypie's Soul Gem to be forged. The success chance is 25% and costs 3 gold per attempt. If an attempt fails the 200 Devil's Soul Stones are gone but the Soul Gem isn't destroyed.

 

An overview of needed materials and gold and the success chances can be found below.

 

By adding an Enchant Insurance Scroll the success chance is increased by 15% and 50% of the needed [u]Devil's Soul Stones[/u] are protected if the attempt fails.

 

By adding an additional Reinforced Insurance Scroll the success chance is increased by another 10% and 75% of the needed [u]Devil's Soul Stones[/u] are protected if the attempt fails.



[b]New Hidden Map for Level 80-85[/b]
We are proud to introduce the new Hidden Map [u]Concordia Pass[/u][b][u]. [/u][/b]Hidden Scrolls for this map are dropped by [u]Harkon[/u] (Snowy Mountain), [u]Elluman[/u] (Forest Glade) and [u]Ailon[/u]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/14/2018
notes.notes:
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.6.42, Game Version: 10.2.1.0
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2018-3-14, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]
 

 

[b]St. Patrick's Day Event[/b]

March, 17th is St. Patrick's Day – and like every year we will celebrate this day with an event. This year you will get the green Leprechaun Costume consisting of Hat, Jacket, Pants, bare Hands, Shoes and the Pot  of Gold (Backpack) again. The Pot of Gold give very special stats: Teleport cost discount: 15% (overridden if the pet skill is available) and Repair cost reduction: 10% (this stat does not "stack"). The costume has the common event costume stats. The whole costume is tradable/sellable but soulbound upon equip.

 

 

You can get a random part of the costume or a part of the Leprechaun Accessory Set (Ring, Necklace, Earrings) by trading 10 Fresh Clover from the world drop at the Vending Machine for the Leprechaun's Box. Every part of the accessory set gives +0.5% Enchant Success Rate and +0.5% Soulcraft Success Rate. If worn as a set you will get additional +1.5% Enchant Success Rate and +1.5% Soulcraft Success rate which finally gives you +3.0% Enchant and Soulcraft Success Rate if worn as a set.

 

[u]The Leprechaun's Box is fully restricted including Account Vault.[/u]

Additionally you can get the following items directly from the Vending Machine as a trade:

St. Patrick's Day Hat (5 Fresh Clover) [u]not sellable/tradable[/u]
St. Patrick's Day Balloon (5 Fresh Clover) [u]not sellable/tradable[/u]
Trefoil Balloon (5 Fresh Clover)
Good Luck! Balloon (30 Fresh Clover)
Good Luck Ring (75 Gada Coins, 25 Fresh Clover) [u]This item is fully restricted including Account Vault![/u]

 

[b]The event will be running until March, 21st 12:00 Server Time[/b]

 


 

[b]File System and Patcher Technology Update[/b]
[b]With this maintenance we will upgrade the game's file system and patcher technology.[/b]

 

The Dragon Saga File System will be updated to use a new compression algorithm and file system structure. This has some advantages:
 

- the game will load maps and streamed objects (textures, models) noticeably faster
- the new file system gives the patcher the possibility to do a file integrity check after patching – this should improve the stability of the patching process and significantly reduce the risk of file corruptions during the patching process
- the files are protected against unauthorized changes
- the content can't be abused for unlicensed/unauthorized usage by a third party

 

The Patcher will be upgraded to work with this new file system technology. This means that the patcher will be automatically replaced before patching. Due to the need that all files have to be migrated to the new file system the patching process will take longer than usual. You will be informed by a message box once that a file migration is needed which you need to confirm by clicking on okay before the patching process continues.

[b][u]Please make sure that you have at least 12 GB of free HD space available during the file migration process.[/u][/b]

 

After the patching process is done the file integrity will be checked to make sure that no downloaded and/or patched files are corrupted.

[b][u]Due to the nature of a file integrity check all files need to be original, unaltered files. Make sure that you are using the original client files and that the files aren't altered ones you might got for example by getting the client from a friend. If the integrity check finds altered files the patching process will [u]fail[/u].[/u][/b]

 

 

[b]As a small "compensation" for the longer patching time we have a little surprise for you. For 50 Fresh Clover you will be able to get the new [u]Helga[/u] Mount which comes with 2 all new attack skills (Ice Cloud and Fire Cloud) and 3 different colors (by using a Pet Dye potion). This mount has been requested by a lot of players in the past but wasn't possible to realize before. [/b]The mount comes with Kero stats.




 

 

 

[b]General Fixes[/b]
- a bug has been fixed which allowed people to enter the Paris boss room at Drakos Lv. 50 without beating Antares first

 

[b]Pet-a-Palooza Item Mall Sale[/b]



For all mount lovers and/or collectors we have a very special sale this week. You can purchase all mounts (except for the Wild Green, Yellow Cat, Mini Red and Blue Thunder) directly from the Item Mall for a reduced price. Grab them for 200 IM Points instead of 300 each.

 

If you like to gamble the Pet-a-Palooza Surprise Box might be right for you. This box contains randomly one of 31 different mounts (including Wild Green, Yellow Cat, Mini Red and Blue Thunder) for only 150 IM Points per box. There are no blanks. You will always get a random mount.

The box randomly contains one of the following mounts:
- Golden Dragon
- Midnight Calm
- Midnight Scream
- Colorful Poodle
- Flying Squirrel
- Sugar Glider
- Pink Flix
- Tabby Flix
- Golden Flix
- White Flix
- Blue Tailed Lizard
- White Pegasus
- Fire Pegasus
- Golden Pegasus
- Dark Pegasus
- Mrs. Husky
- Hover Pro
- Cerberon
- Bruno the Bulldog
- Mini Husky
- Tiger
- Liger
- Pink Feilon
- Blue Bob Car
- Violet Mini Car
- Cool Sportster Car
- Naughty Pink Car
- Mini Red Car
- Yellow Cat Car
- Wild Green Car
- Blue Thunder Car

 

Additionally we are offering a reduced price for the following pet related items:

- Pet Option Randomizers (10 pcs. for 300 IM Points instead of 400)
- Pet Dye Potion (200 IM Points instead of 250)
- Pet Name Changer (230 IM Points instead of 300)

 

[b]Everything can be found at the [u]Promotion->Event [/u]tab[/b]

[b]Healing Penalty[/b]
We have slightly changed the system: If someone heals a team member with a healing skill (Slow Heal, Wide Heal, HP Restore) and the team member is in Penalty State the healing is ignored and no Penalty Points are given to the opposing team. notes.notes:
Patch Notes
 
Maintenance Notes
Patch Version 0.6.36, Game Version: 10.2.0.20
 
Server Maintenance
2018-2-7, 12:00 Server Time
 
Note: Patch notes are subject to change.

 
Carnival Season Event

On Thursday, 2/8 the street carnival is starting in many countries and all the jesters are going wild on the streets. This is a reason for us to celebrate the street carnival season this year with an EXP and grind event.

 

 

By killing monsters you can get a 'Kamelle* Box' which randomly contains one the following:

1x Choppy Chop – a lollipop (consumable) which is able to immediately restore 1300 HP and MP (blocked for use in BSQ)
1x Caramel Kamelle* - a candy (consumable) which is able to immediately restore 1000 HP (blocked for use in BSQ)
1x Fruit Kamelle* - candy (consumable) which is able to immediately restore 1000 MP
1x Half-eaten Choppy Chop – a half-eaten lollipop of which you can trade 5 for a Carnival Mask Box at the Vending Machine

The consumables are tradable, the half-eaten Choppy Chop and the Kamelle Box itself and the Carnival Mask Box are fully restricted.

 

Carnival Mask Box
This box randomly contains one of the 11 masks which can be obtained through the Item Mall as [Event] version or one of the new Carnival Mask in four different colors (red, blue, green, yellow). The Carnival Mask is harder to get but comes with better stats. Also the Carnival Mask is soulbound once equipped.

 

 

The monsters are dropping the Kamelle Box from Thursday, 2/8 0:00 Server Time until Tuesday, 2/13 23:59 Server Time.

*Kamelle: Kamelle is a word from the German Rhineland region which is an important center of the German Carnival Season. The word Kamelle is a regional synonyme for Candy. The word is usually used during the street carnival season where "costumed" trucks are driving through the streets making a parade and costumed carnival people are throwing these candies from the trucks into the viewers who can catch them. While throwing, the throwers shout "Kamelle".


Emporia War Changes

Penalty Points
With the current update we introduce "Penalty Points" for everyone who heals themselves using skills, items, potions or who is being healed by others after changing the island before they have been attacked by an enemy or have attacked an enemy or the core themselves (Summoner's Summons don't count).

Penalty Points are given depending on how many HP the person changing island had before the healed themselves or got healed. The Penalty Points are given as a reward to the opposing team. Penalty Points are given only once. That means that the healing is actually done and the penalty status is gone afterwards. The penalty status is shown by an indicator on the UI

Penalty Points given:
0.01% – 9.99% = 9 Points given to the opposing team
10.00% – 19.99% = 8 Points
20.00% – 39.99% = 7 Points
40.00% – 59.99% = 6 Points
60.00% - 89.99% = 5 Points
90.00% - 94.99% = 4 Points
95.00% - 100.00% = No Penalty

 

User Interface improvement
The Minimap of Emporia Wars have been improved to show which Island is occupied by at least one person of the particular team 


Battlesquare Changes


Points for Flags
The calculation for the points given when a play is carrying flags has been changed. The number of points given is depending on how many flags a player is carrying.

1 Flag = 30 Pts.
2 Flags = 55 Pts.
3 Flags = 75 Pts.
4 Flags = 90 Pts.
5 Flags = 100 Pts.

Every additional flag carried is giving additional 10 Pts.

Flag Carrying Penalty
While a player is carrying one or more flags the following skills are not usable:

Slow Heal (Magician)
Self Heal (Magician)
Wide Heal (Invoker)
HP Restore (Invoker)
Sanctuary (Invoker)
Cure (Invoker)
Atropine (Destroyer)

 

Healing Potions can still be used.
 

Class Adjustments

 

Sorcerer
- Mana Shield is now reducing PAtk and MAtk (PvP and PvE)
- Mana Shield's effect is halved (PvP only)

 

Invoker
- the Diffusion Cannon's damage reduction has been changed to decrease 17.5% every 250ms instead of 7% every 100ms (PvP only)

 

Summoner
- the Helix Shot's damage reduction has been changed to decrease 20% every 200ms instead of 10% every 100ms (PvP only)

- Skill Tree Point adjustments:
Stronger Spell now needs 10 SP each level instead of 15
Summon Mastery now needs 10 SP each level instead of 15
Spike Wave now needs 10 SP each level instead of 15 for the regular 5 Skill Levels
Gather! now needs 10 SP instead of 20
DireMist now needs 15 SP instead of 30
Cry of Life now needs 10 SP each level instead of 15
Advanced Summon Mastery now needs 15 SP each level instead of 20
Attack now needs 10 SP instead of 20
Shot Mastery now needs 10 SP each level instead of 15 for the regular 5 Skill Levels
Elemental Blessing now needs 20 SP each level instead of 25
Impact Unsummon now needs 15 SP instead of 25
Nature Blessing now needs 15 SP each level instead of 20
Hawk Eye now needs 15 SP each level instead of 20

 

Because of the high impact on Skill Points by these changes every summoner above Lv. 40 can get a free Skill Reset Scroll at NPC Syari at Kazeura Village until February, 14th 12:00 Server Time.

General Updates
- a bug has been fixed that the Destroyers was missing the 30% Attack Speed Bonus in PvP

 

BigWheel

Removals:
Everything will be removed 

Additions:
Khaki Knit Set
Goldenrod Knit Set
Pirate Captain Costume
Ultimate Hero Set
 

MixBoard

Removals:
Everything will be removed

Additions:
Tuxedo Set [Advanced Tab]
Wedding Dress Vail Set [Advanced Tab]

Sweetie Attendant (Pink) Outfit [Special Tab]
Chic Attendant (Red) Outfit [Special Tab]

Zeus Set (Artifact) [Deluxe Tab]
Heartless Sword Bear Costume [Deluxe Tab]
[Best] Ultimate Hero Set [Deluxe Tab]

2017-12-20, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]
 

[b]New Option [u]Auto-create Party[/u][/b]

 

The new option [b][u]Auto-create Party when entering Instance[/u][/b] has been added to the options menu at the misc tab. When this option is checked a party (default name, equal loot, 4 players) is created when entering an instanced map (dungeon or mission map) if the entering player isn't currently in a party already. The option is disabled by default. The option is stored locally and affects the client and not a single account or character. If you set this option to enable if will stay enabled even when changing character or account.

The Advent Calendar Event  (25 Days of Christmas) continues until December, 26th 23:59:59 Server Time.

 

[b]X-Mas Event 2017[/b]
This years X-Mas Event will bring you back the X-Mas Mission Map. The event lasts until January, 3rd.

 

[b]X-Mas Event Mission Map[/b]
The X-Mas Mission Map consist of Arcade (F1) Mode, Chaos (F2) Mode and two Scenario Modes (F5). The first Scenario Mode is for the initial questline and the second one is for the daily quest.

[u]Possible mission rewards are:[/u]

 

[u]Arcade (F1) Mode:[/u]
Armor Enchant Dust

Besides this all boss monsters drop Christmas cookies (food for HP/MP regeneration)

 

[b]Main Questline[/b]
After completing 3 quests you will be able to run F5 Scenario Mode daily to obtain 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can be exchanged for a X-Mas Costume Box.

 

[b]The 12 Quests of Christmas[/b]
Beginning with December, 14th you will get a new quest of the quest collection "The 12 Quests of Christmas" daily until December, 25th. The "job" for each of these quests is all around the X-Mas Event Mission Map. The quests can be done until 12/31, 23:59 Server Time. Every quest gives you 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can be exchanged for a winter themed car mount (Winter Rover) or a winter themed sheep mount (Frosty Flix). Also you will get a brand new X-Mas achievement.

[u]Please notice that the car/sheep is neither tradable/sellable nor account vaultable. Since the x-mas quests are beginning with Lvl. 20 we needed to restrict the eggs too to prevent abuse.[/u]

[u]1x Christmas Stocking – contains a part of the new [Event] Yule Costume

1x X-Mas Accessory Box

- One [u]Santa Key (2017)[/u] for 4 Burned Cookies
- One EXP Biscuit for 10 Burned Cookies (1.9x EXP for 30 mins.)
[u]The Biscuit has to be used within one day. Otherwise it expires.[/u]
- A Santa Feilon or Santa Griffon Mount for 20 Burned Cookies each
- A Santa Dark Flip Mount for 30 Burned Cookies.
- One Big IM Consumables Box for 40 Burned Cookies.

When it snows in the lands of Dragon Saga you can have the chance to get a 10 minute EXP bonus randomly between 1.1x ~ 1.5x.

 

*This EXP Bonus applies to Channel 4 as well because it is a buff. If you don't need the bonus EXP it can be cancelled by right clicking on the buff icon in the upper left corner.

 

[b][u]Please notice that all collectable items are neither tradable/sellable nor account vaultable.[/u][/b]

- [u]Yule Weapon Box[/u] added to the Item Mall (Event Tab) for 100 IM Points. The box yields one Yule Weapon for a random class.
The stats for each weapon are: [u]Health +10, Movement Speed +10%, Attack Speed +15%[/u]
- [u]Replaced Flying Squirred[/u] Pet by [u]Sugar Glider Pet[/u]
- Added [u]Hero X-Mas Accessory Box[/u]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed 

 

[u]Additions:[/u]
Rudolph Costume
Tree Man Costume
Ice Penguin Costume
Snowman Costume
Choco Bear Costume
Dashing through the Snow Set

Kill monsters to have a chance to get a [u]Thanksgiving Food Box[/u] dropped.
This year it does not not only contain food but also the chance to get a [u]Thanksgiving Surprise Box[/u] which contains a lot useful  stuff. It can be opened by using a [u]Tur-Key[/u] which can be obtained from the the Food Box as well if you are lucky.

 

[b]Thanksgiving Food Box[/b]
This box randomly gives you one of the following:

[b]Tur-Key[/b]
The [u]Tur-Key [/u]is needed to open the Thanksgiving Surprise Boxes. It can be obtained either from the Thanksgiving Food Boxes, Thanksgiving Surprise Boxes or it can be obtained by exchanging

[u]2x Banana
2x Grape
1x Breadroll
1x Slice of Cake[/u]

for 1 [u]Tur-Key[/u] at the [u]Vending Machine[/u].

 

[b]The event starts on November, 15th at 12:00 Server Time and ends on November, 29th at 12:00 Server Time. After the event has ended no Tur-Keys can be exchanged at the Vending Machine anymore.[/b]

 

 

[b]Friend Points at max Character Level[/b]
Friend Points can now be exchanged when the character is at max level. However only as much friend points as needed to get the ExCo and reset the EXP bar are exchanged. Remaining Friend Points are kept and can be exchanged again.
Friend Points can be now gathered when playing at max level as well.

1x [Event] Pet Option Randomizer
1x [Event] Jack’s Bean
1x [Event] Pet Dye Potion
1x [Event] Pet Name Changer[/u]

 

[b]Tur-Key[/b]
The [u]Tur-Key [/u]is needed to open the Thanksgiving Surprise Boxes. It can be obtained either from the Thanksgiving Food Boxes, Thanksgiving Surprise Boxes or it can be obtained by exchanging

[u]2x Banana
2x Grape
1x Breadroll
1x Slice of Cake[/u]

for 1 [u]Tur-Key[/u] at the [u]Vending Machine[/u].

 

[b]The event starts on November, 15th at 12:00 Server Time and ends on November, 29th at 12:00 Server Time. After the event has ended no Tur-Keys can be exchanged at the Vending Machine anymore.[/b]

 

 

[b]Friend Points at max Character Level[/b]
Friend Points can now be exchanged when the character is at max level. However only as much friend points as needed to get the ExCo and reset the EXP bar are exchanged. Remaining Friend Points are kept and can be exchanged again.
Friend Points can be now gathered when playing at max level as well.

Set of Unity

[b]Halloween 2017 Event[/b]
The spooky time is here. At the center of Port of the Winds Randy awaits you to give you some Halloween Quests.  

 

A whole new event costume is available to obtain. The [u]Grim Reaper Set.[/u]

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/Events/HW2017/GrimReaperSet.jpg[/img]

 

Also you will be able to obtain the little ghost costume by playing the daily mission quest. Along with that you can get all kinds of useful and not useful stuff like Halloween Accessories, Balloons and more. The Event will stay for[u] 4 weeks (until November, 15th)[/u]

Also the [u]Halloween Races[/u] should be available too during the Event period

 

From the Halloween Maps you can obtains as mission rewards:

 

• Small Soul Box

• Armor Dust Box

• Weapon Dust Box

• Tiny HP Eternity Potion

• Tiny MP Eternity Potion

• Double Up EXP Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins)

• Halloween Coin Green (Arcade Mode)

• Halloween Coin Red (Chaos Mode)

• Halloween Weapon Box

• Pumpkin Weapon Box

• Money Bag

• Halloween Hair and Faces Boxes

• Beauty Gasha Box (New Hair Colors & Faces)
 

To enter the Chaos Mode (F2) you need a [New] Torn Invitation.

They are dropped from every "Spirit" monster in the Event Maps.
 

 

[b]Halloween Coins[/b]

All coins are tradable at NPC Randy.

• Green Coins (F1): 3 Coins for 1 Halloween Gasha Box [Arcade] (Humans or Dragokins)

• Red Coins (F2): 3 Coins for 1 Halloween Gasha Box [Chaos] (Humans or Dragokins)

• Blue Coins (F5): 2 Coins for 1 Little Ghost Costume Box

[b]The Grim Reaper Set can be obtained by exchanging 3 Red Coins and 3 Green Coins for one part you can select on your own.[/b]

Following Halloween Mounts have been added to the Item Mall for 300 IM Points each:

Also special Versions of the Dragon Rangers have been added to MixBoard

[b]

[b] [/b]

[b]7th Anniversary farm Event[/b][b]
 [/b][b]Collect Letters from the Alphabet Boxes which are dropped by monsters to trade them at the Vending Machine for stuff.[/b]

Collect [b]HAPPY [/b]and trade those letters for the Anniversary Costume Box #1 which contains randomly one of these items:

Collect [b]BACK [/b]and trade those letters for the Anniversary Back Item Box which contains randomly one of these items:
 [u]Golden Anniversary Cape

Golden Anniversary Muffler
Silver Anniversary Cape
Silver Anniversary Wings
Silver Anniversary Quiver
Silver Anniversary Muffler
Black Anniversary Cape
Black Anniversary Wings
Black Anniversary Quiver
Black Anniversary Muffler[/u]

 

Collect [b]ILIKE [/b]and trade those letters for your personal [b][u]I Like! Ring[/u][/b].

 

[b]ExCo System [/b]and[b] Ancestor Items (Part 1)[/b][b]
 [/b]Just on time for the 7th anniversary of Dragon Saga we are proud to introduce 2 new systems which are connected to each other.

 

[b]ExCo System
 [/b]An ExCo (an abbrevation for Experience Container) is some kind of new currency. Everytime your max level character (currently Level 85) reaches 100% of EXP you get one ExCo which can be traded for some kind of things.

The ExCo trader is our new NPC Lucius. This little guy calls himself a Fallen Angel and wants to rule the world – at least when he is grown up. To take over the world Lucius needs a lot of experience and because of this he wants your Experience Containers (ExCo). Since he is a boy and does not know how to be really evil he gives you something in return (maybe the story of ruling the world is just bragging and he only tries to get rid of his diaper – who knows?).

The following items can be traded:

[Event] +2 Skill Points – 1 ExCo
[Event] Equip Inventory Expansion (1 Slot) – 1 ExCo
[Event] Consumable Inventory Expansion (1 Slot) – 1 ExCo
[Event] Misc Inventory Expansion (1 Slot) – 1 ExCo
[Event] Cash Inventory Expansion (1 Slot) – 1 ExCo
[Event] Pet Dye Potion – 10 ExCo
1* Ring of the Ancestor – 1 ExCo
1* Belt of the Ancestor – 1 ExCo
1* Necklace of the Ancestor – 1 ExCo
1* Bracelet of the Ancestor – 1 ExCo
1* Earrings of the Ancestor – 1 ExCo
 
Lucius can be found at Port of the Winds, Ellora Camp and Arcadia City.
The number of ExCo you have collected can be seen at the MiniMap below the money as soon as your character is Level 85.

 

[b]Ancestor Items (Part 1)
 [/b]Ancestor Items are a new type of items which can be obtained by trading for ExCo with NPC Lucius. After you have obtained one the item can be found in the new [b]Ancestor Vault[/b] which can be accessed at NPC Sofia or NPC Lucius when your character has reached Level 20. The Ancestor Vault can be accessed by every character on the same account.

By double click or right click on one of the Ancestor Items the particular item will be equipped to the new Ancestor Page which can be seen at the Character Overview by pressing the [b]Ancestor[/b] button.

Once equipped the item can’t be put back into the Ancestor Vault. You can either keep it equipped or destroy it by dragging it out of the Ancestor page.

Every item comes with one special stat which should help your low level characters to become a great adventurer.

[b]This is only part 1 of the Ancestor Item system. Part 2 will contain the possibility to upgrade the Ancestor Items to 2* and 3* items. We will release the second part soon.[/b]

 

[b]Fixes and Changes
 [/b]- [u]This is Mine![/u] skill has been added to [u]Feilon[/u] and [u]Fillon[/u] mounts

 

[b]Item Mall
 [/b][u]Ultimate Hero Set [/u]added to the BigWheel
 [u][Best] Ultimate Hero Set [/u]added to the MixBoard

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/4/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.6.6, Game Version: 10.2.0.12
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-10-04, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b]Bishonen Battle![/b]
The [u]Bishonen Battle[/u] is over. Congratulations to the winner [u]Pios[/u] and all the players who own the [u]Pios Balloon[/u]. The stats of the [u]Pios Ballon[/u] have been [b]boosted[/b] and the stats of the [u]Kalygon Balloon[/u] have been [b]removed[/b]. Thanks to everyone who voted for the candidates.

 

[b]Talk like a Pirate Event[/b]
The [u]Talk like a Pirate Event [/u]is over. [u]Captain Hookah[/u] stays for another week of vacation at his usual spot in [u]Port of the Winds [/u]to collect all the leftover booty you gathered.

 

[b]Week of the Mounts[/b]

[b]Welcome to the Week of the Mounts, Dragon Saga Friends![/b] Let’s mount up! Time to take one of the special mounts home you can grab this week – or both.
Let’s welcome Flick and Fillon to the game. You can dye both mounts in 6 various colors by using the [b]Pet Dye Potion[/b] available from the Item Mall or bought from other players.
Both mounts come with stats similar to the Flix. One special stat the Dark Flip is already able to get is included as well. You don’t know what we are talking about? Have fun finding it out!

 

 

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/events/Mounts2017/Fillon_Adv.jpg[/img]

 

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/events/Mounts2017/Flick_Adv.jpg[/img]

You can grab one of those two adorable mounts by farming [u]Silver Coins[/u] and [u]Gada Coins[/u] and exchanging them for  [u]100 Silver Coins[/u] and [u]75 Gada Coins[/u] at the [u]Vending Machine[/u].

[u]The [b]eggs[/b] of these two mounts can be sold in the open market (no character level restriction) and COD-mailed by characters Lv. 50+. The [b]hatched mounts[/b] are [b]fully restricted[/b] except for the [b]Account Vault[/b].[/u]

 

[b]New Achievements
[u]We are proud to present a completely new type of achievements which are triggered by picking up the particular monster drop.[/u]

Silver Coin Collector[/b]
[u]Collect 1000 Silver Coins from Monsters[/u]
Enchant Success Rate +1.5%, Soulcraft Success Rate +1.5%

[b]Silver Coin Broker[/b]
[u]Collect 2500 Silver Coins from Monsters[/u]
Enchant Success Rate +2.0%, Soulcraft Success Rate +2.0%

 

[b]Silver Coin Billionaire[/b]
[u]Collect 5000 Silver Coins from Monsters[/u]
Enchant Success Rate +2.5%, Soulcraft Success Rate +2.5%

[u]Slay two birds with one stone and work for these achievements while already farming your new mount![/u]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

·         A bug has been fixed where the basic hair 10 (also available in the Item Mall as Layer Wolfcut) tended to have a bad hair day. Which means that it reacted strange to the assigned hair color which appeared brighter than it actually is when the hair was in a bad mood.

 

·         Fixed a bug that the drop rate of the [Best] Emergency Gas Mask in Farrell Expert Mode Dungeon was way too low. It should drop as intended now.

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

[b]Pet Dye Potion[/b]
All newly purchased Pet Dye Potions will be put into your Cash inventory and not longer into the pet inventory. This has been done to prevent the ongoing confusion players are experiences when buying it from the Item Mall.

[b]Pet Name Changer[/b]
All newly purchased Pet Name Changers will be put into your Cash inventory and not longer into the pet inventory. This has been done to prevent the ongoing confusion players are experiences when buying it from the Item Mall



[b]Pet Dye Potion / Pet Name Changer Change[/b]

The change of the target Inventory made it possible for us to make the [u]Pet Dye Potion[/u] and the [u]Pet Name Changer[/u] [b]sellable/COD-mailable by players Lv. 50[/b]+.
Due to a [b]technical limitation[/b] this only applies to [u]Pet Dye Potions/Pet Name Changers[/u] [b]bought after this maintenance is complete (October, 4th 12:00 Server Time). The old ones remain in the pet inventory and are used first.[/b]

This change also made it possible to create [u][Event][/u] version of both items which will appear in future events. They can be identified by the letter [b]E[/b] at the [b]bottom right corner[/b] of the item.

The order of usage is: Old items from the Pet Inventory, [Event] Pet Items and then the IM items when used to dye/name change a pet.

 

[b]Hover Pro – Hover Car Mount[/b]
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/events/Mounts2017/HoverPro.jpg[/img]

 

[b]The Hover Pro combines the elegant design of a Hover with the stats of a Car Mount. It comes with 6 different colors. You can get one of them randomly using a Pet Dye Potion.[/b]

To celebrate the introduction of this elegant mount you can get it from the Item Mall together with one [u][Event] Pet Dye Potion[/u] for only [b]350 IM Points[/b] starting from [b]October, 4th 12:00[/b] [b]Server Time[/b] until [b]October, 11th 12:00 Server Time[/b]. When this introduction period is over you can still get the mount from the [b]Item Mall[/b] for the regular price without the [Event] Pet Dye Potion.

notes.title: Patch Notes 09/13/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.6.1, Game Version: 10.2.0.11b
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-09-13, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]
 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/700x175_PirateDay-e1504899607225.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Talk like a Pirate! Day Event
[u]"[/u][/b][u]Why are pirates pirates? cuz they arrrrrr"[/u]

The Event Season has begun! Another two weeks long event for you guys to enjoy. Captain Hookah heard about the loot to farm which came into the game with the revelation of Arcadia City. And guess what! He arrived at Port of the Winds. Show him that you're worth getting his treasures! Run the Pirate's Hideout! Mission Map, collect Shiny Diamonds (Mission End Result) and Bronze, Silver and Golden Woodie Statues (these are contained in boxes dropped by the Mission Boss Monsters) to trade with the Captain!

This is a re-used event from last year, because of two reasons: The community liked it and we were a bit in lack of time to create a new one.

Here is the Event information from last year:

[u]Pirate's Hideout Event[/u]

[u]Arg me mateys! The great Pirate Hideout has been discovered in Dragon Saga!

There be a new event mission map in town, and it be for all level o' players past level 25, with monsters that scale to yer level! Run the Pirate's Hideout F1 Mission Map to obtain marvelous treasures in the form of mission rewards. 

Once ye have made it through the perilous gauntlet of Pirates and scallywags, at the end of this mission you will see two deadly bosses. One of them is the terrifying Hookah, but the other changes with the shifting sea! You will either face off with Alvida or Kalygon . Once you have battled these monstrous foes, they will drop grand pirate treasure chests! Be ye careful though, all monsters in the finale boss room will have to be killed to complete the map.

You may find inside this treasure chest a Slice of Cake, Yogurt, a Balloon, a treasure piece or, if ye be unlucky, junk! Don't worry though; you can always be selling the junk treasure for 10 silver to any shop NPC.

What about them glittery treasure pieces ye ask? The treasure pieces be needed to be exchanged to a Chucky's Clothing Gasha Box, which may be randomly yields a pirate clothing!

As fer them shiny mission end rewards, ye can get:

Repair Hammers
An EXP potion
Weapon Enchant Dust
Armor Enchant Dust
Souls
A Pirate's Weapon Gasha Box (only S~SSS Rank)
Pirate's Diamonds (only S~SSS Rank)

Ye can also trade 4 Golden Woodie Statues, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Woodie Statues at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Barter ye Booty' (level 25+). If ye be wanting to unlock this repeatable quest you have to complete Hookah's 'Enter th' Hideout' Quest (Level 25+) once on yer pirate fightin' character.

And if ye have some of them Pirate Diamonds, ye can trade 5 at a time at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Shiny Diamonds' (Level 25+) for a Big IM Consumable Gasha Box which randomly yields IM Consumables.

So go get that pirate treasure, before the time is up, and those scurvy pirates sail back out to sea![/u]

 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

- [u]NPC Andre[/u] can now be found in [u]Arcadia City[/u]
- the [u]Port of the Winds Farm[/u] has been renamed to [u]Windy Farm[/u] because it can be accessed from other cities as well
- the [u]Windy Farm[/u] can now be accessed from [u]Arcadia City[/u]
- [u]Snowy Mountain[/u] and [u]Forest Glade Chaos Scrolls[/u] are now worth 70 silver each and can be obtained by trading for 6 [u]Devil Soul Stones[/u] each
- added background music to the [u]Snowy Mountain[/u] field map
- [u]NPC Quywcha[/u] in [u]Kazeura[/u] has no longer a big mouth. Means the oversized speech bubble of [u]NPC Quywcha[/u] has been fixed
- corrected [u]Twin[/u] Skill description for [u]Release Fighter Force[/u]
 

 

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Jaguar Doll Costume
Leaf Raincoat
Tiger-patterned Hoodie
Cutie Attendant Fancy Set

[b]MixBoard [/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Casual Rocker Popstar (male) [Advanced Tab]

Vintage Popstar (female) [Advanced Tab]

Captain Popstar (male) [Special Tab]
Captain Popstar (female) [Special Tab]
Rune Knight Set (male) [Special Tab]

Rune Knight Set (female) [Special Tab]

Artemis Set  [Deluxe Tab]
Heartless Sword Bear Costume [Deluxe Tab]

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.6.00, Game Version: 10.2.0.11b
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-09-06, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

[b]UI Enhancement: "New Quest" Dialog – Part 2[/b]
The "New Quest" Dialog has been enhanced more. 
- the list is now sorted by their minimum level in a descending order
- the selected filter options are now saved for the current session. This means they are only reset when the client is restarted.
- the minimum needed level for the quest is now shown in the list as well
- Jobchange quests are now differently colored (purple) in the hero quest list and are shown as [Jobchange] and not longer as [Hero].

 

[b]Fixes and Changes[/b]
- fixed a bug that the monsters in [u]Forest Glade[/u] are not dropping items
- the [u]High Priest Set (female)[/u] no longer shows (male) in the name of it's particular parts
- some of the daily quests for Verglas Ridge and Bear Claw Mine were sorted into the wrong location. This has been fixed
- the [u][Event] Black Dragon Lord Weapon Recipe [/u]can now be obtained without the need of killing Elga before
- the "normal" [u]Black Dragon Lord Weapon Recipe[/u] quest is now available together with the first "slay Elga" quest
- the [u]Black Dragon Lord Weapons[/u] are now sellable and tradable but are still soulbound after equiped

 

[b]MixBoard and BigWheel[/b]
Mixboard and Bigwheel will change next week.

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.97, Game Version: 10.2.0.11
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-08-30, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

[b]Specialist: Flash Bang[/b]
The white screen effect of Flash Bang has been removed. Instead the enemy who has been hit by Flash Bang is now stunned for a certain amount of time:
Lv. 1: 1.9s
Lv.2: 2.5s
Lv.3: 2.9s
Lv.4: 3.3s
Lv.5: 4.0s

Please test this change and give feedback.

 

 

[b]Monster Card System [/b]
The blend success rate has been increased from 25% to 33%. When using a Card Insurance Scroll the success rate will increase to 50%.
 

 

[b]UI Enhancement: "New Quest" Dialog[/b]
The "New Quest" Dialog has been enhanced. The "New Quest" Dialog is the dialog that comes up when you have new quests available and you click on the red or yellow exclamation mark above your level indicator.

 

[u]General changes[/u]
- the dialog is a bit wider in size so the name of the quests fit better

[u]Hero Quest List[/u]
- nothing has changed to this list

 

[u]Non-Hero Quest List (the list which contains all other types of quests)[/u]
- above the quest name now the quest type (Event, Repeatable, Daily, etc.)  is shown
- a quest type filter has been added to the dialog to hide unwanted quest types

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/DS-UI.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Fixes[/b]
- fixed a bug that Cold Mossy Bone Gunstaff, Cold Mossy Bone Gauntlet, Fiery Cursed Bone Gunstaff and Fiery Cursed Bone Gaunlet were not able to cast skills or X-attack
- fixed a bug Cold Mossy Bone Gunstaff and Fiery Cursed Bone Gunstaff only had 30 durability instead of 120

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.95, Game Version: 10.2.0.10
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-08-23, 12:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]
 
[b]Grinding Event[/b]
Wanna grind again? Kill monsters and collect Mixed Material Boxes. From those boxes you can get materials which can be traded for MyHome furniture at the Vending Machine. The furniture gives buffs and does not expire. It can also be sold in the open market. Want to know more? Have a look at the Vending Machine! This event runs until September, 6th.
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]
 
 
[b]Guild UI Fixes [/b]
The known issues with the enhanced Guild UI have been fixed. The button to sort by activity is now sorting correctly and the members are show in the correct color if they are online.
 
[b]Specialist: Flashbang[/b]
The Flashbang skill is now working as intended (which means that the synchronization malfunction has been fixed) and therefore the Stun workaround has been removed. The character hit by Flashbang is now not able to move or attack for 3 seconds (which is the amount of time this skill always had).
 
[b]Player Appreciation Week[/b]
Everyone who gets the WarpPortal newsletter already knows that we will be having a player appreciation week for all games where the bonus for converting to IM points is higher than normal starting on August, 27th. More details about this can be found here: [url=http://blog.warpportal.com/?p=9910]http://blog.warpportal.com/?p=9910[/url]
 
[b]We are adding more sales![/b] From [b]Monday, August 28th 12:00 Server Time[/b] until [b]Monday, September 4th 12:00[/b] Server Time you can get  [b]50% more[/b] on selected items:
 
[b]During this sale event, you will get 15 instead of 10 of the following items:[/b]
W-Coins, Enchant Insurance Scrolls, Reinforced Enchant Insurance Scroll, Soulcraft Randomizer, Pet Option Randomizer
 
[b][u]Please keep your timezone in mind! The sales are starting at 12:00 Server Time. Since the Server Time is UTC-7 the sales are starting at 19:00 UTC, 21:00 CEST.[/u][/b]

Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]

Skater Set (male)

[u]Removals:[/u]

The number of members in the guild and the maximum number of guild members possible for the particular guild level are now displayed

Red color: Member has been logged in within the last 15~30 days
Grayed out: Members has not logged in for 31 days or more[/u]

Warrior x1.3 (PvE x1.4)

Archer x1.2 (PvE x1.2)

Thief x1.3 (PvE x1.3)

If you think that some further adjustments are needed please tell us why you think it's necessary.

[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]

[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/1000x320_SummerEvent.jpg[/img]

 

Due to the impact of the DDoS attacks the Summer Event has been extended by another week until August, 16th.
 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

The limitations of Fast Emotions (Alt+Number Key) and Fast Chat Access have been removed from PvE. The limitations have been removed from PvP while the character is showing the die animation. Speech bubbles have been removed from PvP on the client side when they're used while skills are running because the chat bar was activated before the skill is used. This was necessary to keep the server synchronized.
 

[b]EXP Event[/b]

We have decided to run a longer EXP Event for you to catch up the lost time last week:

 

Wednesday, 8/2: 2.0x (starts after the weekly maintenance)
Thursday, 8/3: 2.0x
Friday, 8/4: 2.5x
Saturday, 8/5: 2.5x
Sunday, 8/6: 2.5x
Monday, 8/7: 2.0x
Tuesday, 8/8: 2.0x
Wednesday, 8/9: 2.0x
Thursday, 8/10: 2.0x

 

[b]Class Adjustments (Testing Phase)[/b]

As everyone can see in the published damage calculation which can be found on the forums the magical classes (Magician, Shaman and the derived classes) always get their damage multiplied by a hard coded multiplier of 1.5 while all physical classes had none. After discussing this in the team we came to the conclusion that we don't want to remove that multiplier from the magic classes. Even though we are fully aware these classes are the strongest DPS dealers. That brought us to the solution to give the physical classes their own multiplier which can be adjusted now class-wise to a maximum of 1.5 if needed/wanted. Anyway we set the current multiplicators to the following amounts:

 

Warrior x1.3
Knight/Paladin/Dragoon x1.3
Gladiator/Myrmidone/Overlord x1.3

Archer x1.2
Hunter/Pathfinder/Sentinel x1.3
Marksman/Specialist/Destroyer x1.2

Thief x1.3
Bandit/Rogue/Savage x1.3
Infiltrator/Assassin/Ninja x1.3

Twin Figher/Twin/Mirage/Jumeaux x1.2

 

Please try it out and give us some feedback. We are able to adjust those amounts in both directions between x1.0 and x1.5 for each class separately.

[b]The shown PATK/MATK values on the character info screen are now reflecting the multiplier as well.[/b]

Everything will be removed

Gray Beach Fun Set
Orange Beach Fun Set

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.89, Game Version: 10.2.0.5
 
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-07-19, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/1000x320_SummerEvent.jpg[/img]

 

Summer is here and the temperature is rising. What could be better than going to the beach, jumping into the cool water and enjoying the summer sun? Fighting monsters and getting some nice event stuff for sure! Take your gear and help the small baby dragon [u]Yongha[/u] out with his problem at the [u]Summer Wave Coast[/u]. A lot of nice stuff is awaiting you.

 

When entering [u]Summer Wave Coast[/u] an instanced map with end reward boxes is ready for you. The map can be entered starting with Level 25. The levels of the monsters are auto scaling to the level of the party leader. The map can only be entered if the level difference of all party members is not higher than [b]5 levels[/b].

Some of the monsters are dropping an item which can be traded with the [u]Baby Dragon NPC Yongha[/u] for one of four boxes containing random stuff:
 

·  [b]Cool Summer Costume Box[/b]
contains 2 different event costumes which are fully tradable, but soulbound once equipped

 

·  [b]Cool Summer Rummage Box[/b]
contains a lot of summer accessory stuff including some highlights

 

·  [b]Cool Summer Pet Box[/b]
contains 3 Lv. 20 Summer Pets from last year (Twinkle, DingDong and Tutti) and 2 new Lv.20 Summer Pets (Butterfly and Veggie). Pet eggs are tradable, the pet itself is not.
[b][u]The stats of all 5 pets have been adjusted and are the same as for the Paris' Spirit Pet.[/u][/b]

[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b]Ultrathon EXP Event [/b]


The Ultrathon EXP Event is ending.

 


[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]


- A bug has been fixed that parts of the [u]Devil's Set of Agility[/u] are invisible for Dragonkin classes
- A bug has been fixed that the top and/or gloves of the [u]Arcadia's Destiny Set (BigWheel)[/u] are pink for Dragonkin classes
- the guild annoucement length has been increased from 100 to 200 characters. If the width of the text is bigger than the size of the text box less characters are possible.



[b]Class Balances (testing phase)[/b]

[b]
Invoker[/b]
- the effect range of the [u]Lightning Magnet[/u] skill has been reduced by 30% [b](PvP only)[/b]
- the cooldown of the [u]Lightning Magnet[/u] skill has been increased to 30 seconds [b](PvP only)[/b]

 

[b]Monk[/b]
- the casttime of [u]Wide Heal [/u]has been increased: Lv. 1: 1.5s (original), Lv.2:1.4s, Lv.3:1.3s, Lv.4:1.25s, Lv.5~10: 12s [b](PvP/PvE)[/b]

 

[b]Priest[/b]
- the duration of the [u]Muddy Mud [/u]debuff has been reduced to 5/6/7.5/9/10 sec. [b](PvP/PvE)[/b]

 

[b]Pathfinder[/b]
- the cooldown time of [u]Tesla Coil[/u] has been increased to 9/10/11/12/13 sec. [b](PvP/PvE)[/b]


[b]Elementalist[/b]
- the cooldown time of [u]Rolling Stone [/u]has been increased by 8 sec. [b](PvP only)[/b]

 

[b]Rogue[/b]
- the cooldown time of [u]Head Spin[/u] has been increased by 3 sec. [b](PvP only)[/b]

 

[b]Skill Fix [u]Fire Ink (Warlock)[/u][/b]

[b]
The skill has been renamed to [u]Octopus Ink Gun[/u][/b]
The skill uses an Octopus Gun which hits targets one time with an ink cloud dealing damage and has a chance of stunning when enemies are hit. The caster is unable to move while using the skill.

Lv. 1:
hits up to 6 targets dealing 150% of the Weapon's Damage + 100 with a chance of 15% to stun. Cooldown time is 20sec.

Lv. 2:
hits up to 8 targets dealing 170% of the Weapon's Damage + 200 with a chance of 20% to stun. Cooldown time is 19sec.

Lv. 3:
hits up to 10 targets dealing 180% of the Weapon's Damage + 300 with a chance of 25% to stun. Cooldown time is 18sec.
Lv. 4:
hits up to 12 targets dealing 190% of the Weapon's Damage + 400 with a chance of 30% to stun. Cooldown time is 17sec.

Lv. 5:
hits up to 14 targets dealing 200% of the Weapon's Damage + 500 with a chance of 40% to stun. Cooldown time is 16sec.

Lv. 6:
hits up to 14 targets dealing 220% of the Weapon's Damage + 600 with a chance of 45% to stun. Cooldown time is 15sec.

Lv. 7:
hits up to 14 targets dealing 240% of the Weapon's Damage + 700 with a chance of 45% to stun. Cooldown time is 15sec.

Lv. 8:
hits up to 14 targets dealing 260% of the Weapon's Damage + 800 with a chance of 45% to stun. Cooldown time is 15sec.

Lv. 9:
hits up to 14 targets dealing 280% of the Weapon's Damage + 900 with a chance of 45% to stun. Cooldown time is 15sec.

Lv. 10:
hits up to 14 targets dealing 300% of the Weapon's Damage + 1000 with a chance of 50% to stun. Cooldown time is 15sec.

 

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]
The Arcadia's Destiny Set  will be removed



[b]MixBoard[/b]
The [Best] Arcadia's Destiny Set [Deluxe Tab]  will be removed

notes.title: Patch Notes 05/31/2017 Arcadia Episode 2
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]

 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.70, Game Version: 10.2.0.0

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-05-31, 1030 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[u][img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Banner_700x236.jpg[/img][/u]

 

[b]Dragon Saga Arcadia Episode 2 – The Return[/b]

 

[b]New Dungeon Mode – Expert Mode Dungeons[/b]
The Expert Mode Dungeons can be entered starting 5 levels above their original entry level.. All party members must have completed the original dungeon hero quest line to be able to enter.

 

[b]Restrictions[/b]

- Max. level difference between party members: 5 levels
- Joining parties inside the dungeon is not possible
- Equipment can't be changed within the dungeon
- Critical Damage above 100% is halved (base Critical Damage is 150%)
- No Element Damage can be dealt
- Monsters do not respawn
- All monsters have to be killed to move on to the next map
- Safety Foam/Rest of Piece can't be used

 

[b]Advantages[/b]
- Durability decrease is halved
- Eight end rewards
- Elemental Debuff Effects can be triggered (though Element Damage is not dealt)
- Special Expert Mode Dungeon end rewards
- Increased EXP amount

 

There are new rewards in each Expert Dungeon that can be obtained. The rewards can be sold and have a higher minimum equipment level than the original items and have stronger stats. All items from the normal dungeons are dropped too. Some Expert Mode dungeons have new items for you to farm. A complete list of items will follow later.

The following dungeons have an expert mode:
City Hall Sewers, Underground Graveyard Lv. 30, Underground Graveyard Lv. 35, Verdurous Forest, Akia Cave, Kundara Dungeon, Red Fox Delta, Van Cliff Citadelle and Drakos.

 

[b]New System for accepting Daily Quests[/b]
The quests are still created randomly but can be accepted in an individual order. In the list the quests are sorted regarding their quest target area. The quests still give increasing EXP the more you complete. That system hasn't changed.

 

[b]New System for obtaining Monster Cards[/b]
Monster Cards can now be obtained by doing daily quests similar to Hunter G and Guild Dailies. You get increasing EXP for every quest you do. The amount is half of the EXP you get for the other dailies. After completing 5th and 10th quest you get a token (MC Coin) which can be traded in for monster cards or a monster card box which is cheaper but contains one monster card of the particular tier randomly. The new NPC is currently only available in Port of the Winds but will be added to the other cities in one of the upcoming maintenances. The name of the NPC is Andre and he's a mummy.

 

[b]New Monster Cards[/b]
New Monster Cards for Level 40+ skills have been added for each class.

 

[b]Arcadia Storyline – The Return[/b]
Enjoy 64 new hero quests for the level range 68~78 with a decent amount of EXP. It's up to you to save Arcadia once more.  Explore new horizons and show everyone you're a true hero!

 

[b]Class Balance[/b]
This is the first step of class balance – more will follow.

[u]Summoner:[/u]
The final damage amplification of the passive buff [u]Nation Fury [/u]has been halved for PvP and PvE. The health amount remain.
In PvP the Roaring Victory Buff has been adjusted to behave similar to the one from the Invoker for the X-Attack expansion (Helix Shot).

[u]Destroyer:[/u]
In PvP the Roaring Victory Buff has been adjusted to behave similar to the one from the Invoker for the X-Attack expansion (Random Shot).

 

[b]Element Debuffs[/b]
Attacking enemies has a random chance of causing element debuff effects. The chance depends on which element points have been applied and how many. Also it depends on the element defense of the attacked enemy (PvP).

The debuff effects and durations are differently either if a player is attacked or a monster. After an element debuff has been triggered you can not trigger another element debuff for a certain amount of time (cooldown). If you have debuffed a player the player is in a recovery phase of 20 seconds – which means no one can debuff this player again for the next 20 seconds.

 

[b]PvE debuffs (debuffs monsters can receive) are:[/b]
Fire – Stone Paralysis (Petrification) - stops the monster completely for 5 seconds, the monster is not able to attack
Ice – Cold – reduces the Movement Speed of the monster by 80% for 5 seconds
Nature – Entangle Root – stops the monster completely for 5 seconds but it's still able to deal melee attacks
Dark – Black Hole – reduces the monster's HP by 1% each second for 5 seconds

[u]The cooldown time between dealing the possible debuff effects is 30 seconds.
Boss monsters and elite monsters are not affected by PvE debuffs.[/u]

 

[b]PvP debuffs (debuffs players can receive) are:[/b]
Fire – I'm on Fire - Attack Speed is decreased by 75% for 7 seconds
Ice – Frozen - Movement Speed is decreased by 75% for 7 seconds
Nature – Biohazard - Drains HP and MP by 3% each second for a duration of 5 seconds
Dark – Sickness - Dealing critical damage is not possible for a duration of 10 seconds

[u]The cooldown time between dealing the possible debuff effects is 50 seconds.[/u]

 

Cooldown and Recovery time are always the same. An element which has set points to has always the chance of dealing a debuff at at least 0.1% but never more than 5.0%.

The debuffs only affect a single target.

 

[b]Known issues[/b]
Due to an incooperative game some stuff is still missing and will be added in the next maintenance:
- NPCs faces for the new NPCs
- 2 Teleport Towers
- A mission map and boss UI image (currently has the Hookah pictures)
- some planned class balance is still missing and will be added
- the dungeon description of Van Cliff states the wrong modes

[b]Easter Blossom Event 2017 – The last Week![/b]
Prepare for the last week of the Easter Blossom Event. Please know if you start freshly with the quest "Easter and Cherry Blossom United" you're not able to gather enough golden eggs/perfect cherry blossoms to complete it (it takes 15 days). So you can skip this quest. You can still farm the colored and the silver eggs to exchange them for stuff at NPC Alba.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

·         A bug with the [Event] Rising Sun Car mount has been fixed which set the car to be at Stage 6 and made it unable to advance the skills
[u]After the bug is fixed your mount will be at Stage 1 keeping the already achieved level and pet options. You can go to any Pet Merchant NPC and advance the car to the appropriate stage[/u]

·         Some quest texts has been corrected

·         The Colorful Poodle mount can now be sold in open market like any other IM mount
 

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

The Colorful Poodle mount has been replaced by Midnight Scream

Some interiors for your MyHome have been added to the Item Mall:

Vyburn Picture Frame (350 IM) – [u]Increases Matk by 4% for 2 hours[/u]
Happy Family Picture Frame (400 IM) – [u]Increases Matk by 5% for 3 hours[/u]
Lilly of the Valley Vase (300 IM) – [u]Increases Movement Speed by 3% for 1 hour[/u]
Zen Vase (300 IM) – [u]Increases Movement Speed by 3% for 1 hour[/u]
QQ Vase (300 IM) – [u]Increases Movement Speed by 3% for 1 hour[/u]
Luxurious Golden Pot (400 IM) – [u]Increases Movement Speed by 5% for 3 hour[/u]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Banner_700x236.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Easter Cherry Blossom Event[/b]

 

Haruka as back, and she needs your help to stop the chef from doing bad stuff. But this is not all. The Little Spring Fairy Alba needs your help in the Easter Forest. Both NPCs can be found at the center island at Ports of the Winds.

 

Collect Easter Eggs to exchange them with Alba for great stuff. You can trade them for:

·         Cherry Blossom Costume Accessory Gasha Box

·         Easter Costume Accessory Gasha Box

·         Cherry Blossom Balloon Gasha Box

·         Easter Balloon Gasha Box

·         Kimono/Spring Party Set Gasha Box

·         Soverign Sunflower Set Gasha Box

·         Easter Blossom Set Gasha Box

 

Also the boss monsters of both maps can drop a special weapon box by a low chance. The weapons in it are spring themed IM weapons.

There is a daily quest for both maps which gives Perfect Cherry Blossoms (Haruka's Sushi Restaurant) and Golden and Silver Easter Eggs (Easter Forest). Don't throw these items away you can use them to complete a special reward quest from Alba.

You can get the Cherry Blossom Accessories (normal, chaos and new) in a box which can be obtained as mission result reward (rank S~SSS).

The Easter Lily Accessory Set can be obtained as a drop from the boss monster in the Easter Forest.

The Silver Eggs can be traded with NPC Alba for a Big IM Consumables Box.

The Event lasts until May, 3rd.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

Removed the "Attack Range" stat from Earth Master's Secmathian Set (3 parts) and replaced it by a different one (all grades: normal, rare, hero). We found out that this ability is bugged when used on sets. If you have any problems with this ability on other items please let us know.

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]

 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.54, Game Version: 10.1.0.14

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-03-15, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/DS-St-Pats-Celebrations.jpg[/img]

 

[b]St. Patrick's Day Event[/b]
March, 17th is St. Patrick's Day – and like every year we will celebrate this day with an event. This year you don't only get the usual St. Patrick's Day Hat and the St. Patrick's Day Balloon you can also get a whole green Leprechaun Costume consisting of Hat, Jacket, Pants, bare Hands, Shoes and the Pot  of Gold (Backpack). The Pot of Gold give very special stats: Teleport cost discount: 15% (overridden if the pet skill is available) and Repair cost reduction: 10% (this stat does not "stack"). The costume has the common event costume stats. The whole costume is tradable/sellable but soulbound upon equip.

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/events/StPD17/StPDEv2017.jpg[/img]

 

You can get a random part of the costume or a part of the Leprechaun Accessory Set (Ring, Necklace, Earrings) by trading 10 Gold Coins from the world drop at the Vending Machine for the Leprechaun's Box. Every part of the accessory set gives +0.5% Enchant Success Rate and +0.5% Soulcraft Success Rate. If worn as a set you will get additional +1.5% Enchant Success Rate and +1.5% Soulcraft Success rate which finally gives you +3.0% Enchant and Soulcraft Success Rate if worn as a set.

[u]The Leprechaun's Box is fully restricted including Account Vault.[/u]

 

Additionally you can get the following items directly from the Vending Machine as a trade:

St. Patrick's Day Hat (5 Silver Coins) [u]not sellable/tradable[/u]
St. Patrick's Day Balloon (5 Silver Coins) [u]not sellable/tradable[/u]
Trefoil Balloon (5 Silver Coins)
Good Luck! Balloon (30 Silver Coins)
Good Luck Ring (75 Gada Coins, 25 Silver Coins) [u]This item is fully restricted including Account Vault![/u]

 

[b]The event will be running until March, 22nd 15:00 Server Time[/b]

 

[b]BigWheel / MixBoard[/b]
The current MB/BW will be staying for an extra week! New items will be traded out with next weeks maintenance.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2/22/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]

 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.47, Game Version: 10.1.0.13

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2017-02-22, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b]Valentine's Day Event[/b]

This will be the last week the Cookie Factory is open! Make sure to get the items and cookie ingredients you need before it will be closed next week.

 

[b]Carnival Season Event[/b]

On Thursday, 2/23 the street carnival is starting in many countries and all the jesters are going wild on the streets. This is a reason for us to celebrate the street carnival season this year with an EXP and grind event.

 

By killing monsters you can get a 'Kamelle* Box' which randomly contains one the following:

 

1x Choppy Chop – a lollipop (consumable) which is able to immediately restore 1300 HP and MP [u](blocked for use in BSQ)[/u]
1x Caramel Kamelle* - a candy (consumable) which is able to immediately restore 1000 HP [u](blocked for use in BSQ)[/u]
1x Fruit Kamelle* - candy (consumable) which is able to immediately restore 1000 MP
1x Half-eaten Choppy Chop – a half-eaten lollipop of which you can trade 10 for a Carnival Mask Box at the Vending Machine

[u]The consumables are tradable, the half-eaten Choppy Chop and the Kamelle Box itself and the Carnival Mask Box are fully restricted.[/u]

 

[b]Carnival Mask Box[/b]
This box randomly contains one of the 11 masks which can be obtained through the Item Mall as [Event] version or one of the new Carnival Mask in four different colors (red, blue, green, yellow). The Carnival Mask is harder to get but comes with better stats. Also the Carnival Mask is soulbound once equipped.

 

[b]The monsters are dropping the Kamelle Box from Thursday, 2/23 0:00 Server Time until Tuesday, 2/29 23:59 Server Time.[/b]

 

[u]*Kamelle: Kamelle is a word from the German Rhineland region which is an important center of the German Carnival Season. The word Kamelle is a regional synonym for Candy. The word is usually used during the street carnival season where "costumed" trucks are driving through the streets making a parade and costumed carnival people are throwing these candies from the trucks into the viewers who can catch them. While throwing, the throwers shout "Kamelle".[/u]

 

[b]EXP Event[/b]
An EXP Event will be running on Thursday, 2/23 0:00 Server Time until Tuesday, 2/28 23:59 Server Time. The EXP rates will be announced in a separate announcement.

 

 

[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed a bug that prevents people from entering the Galaxia dungeons without creating a party beforehand. This fix results in the fact that a party is automatically created when entering dungeons and mission maps. If this behavior is not wanted please let us know.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

The cutscenes in the boss room of Drakos can now be skipped by pressing ESC.
