notes.title: Patch Notes 12/14/2016
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]

 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.30, Game Version: 10.1.0.10

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2016-12-14, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b][img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Banner_1000x320.jpg[/img][/b]


This years X-Mas Event will bring you back the X-Mas Mission Map. The event lasts until January, 4th.

 

[b]X-Mas Event Mission Map[/b]
The X-Mas Mission Map consist of Arcade (F1) Mode, Chaos (F2) Mode and two Scenario Modes (F5). The first Scenario Mode is for the initial questline and the second one is for the daily quest.

[u]Possible mission rewards are:[/u]

 

[u]Arcade (F1) Mode:[/u]
Armor Enchant Dust
Weapon Enchant Dust
Souls
EXP Double Up Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins.)
X-Mas Ballon Box (contains different balloons only)
X-Mas Accessory Box (contains different X-Mas accessories like the Carrot Nose)
X-Mas Santa Costume Box (contains Santa Costume in Pink, Red, Green and White)
X-Mas Jewelry Box (Advanced Grade) (contains Christmas Skill Accessories)
X-Mas Furniture Box (Arcade) (contains different MyHome furniture)
Frost Weapon Box (contains Frost Weapons – former the IM Ice Weapons, the weapons have been renamed to not collide with the element Ice Weapons name wise)

[u]Chaos (F2) Mode:[/u]
Armor Enchant Dust
Weapon Enchant Dust
Souls
EXP Double Up Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins.)
X-Mas Ballon Box (contains different balloons only)
X-Mas Accessory Box (contains different X-Mas accessories like the Carrot Nose)
X-Mas Santa Costume Box (contains Santa Costume in Pink, Red, Green and White)
X-Mas Jewelry Box (Rare Grade) (contains Christmas Skill Accessories)
X-Mas Furniture Box (Chaos) (contains different MyHome furniture)
Magical Ice Weapon Box (contains Magical Ice Weapons)

Besides this all boss monsters drop Christmas cookies (food for HP/MP regeneration)

 

[b]Main Questline[/b]
This year a new special initial quest has been added which is called [u]Rolling around the Christmas Tree.[/u] You will get a scroll which can be used to enter the mission room. If you lose that scroll (for example by accidentally destroying it or because you died in the mission room) you can just talk to the Rudolph NPC again to get another one. For this quest you'll get a very nice reward.

When this quest is finished the main questline starts. After completing 3 quests you will be able to run F5 Scenario Mode daily to obtain 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can be exchanged for a X-Mas Costume Box.

 

[b]The 12 Quests of Christmas[/b]
Beginning with December, 14th you will get a new quest of the quest collection "The 12 Quests of Christmas" daily until December, 25th. The "job" for each of these quests is all around the X-Mas Event Mission Map. The quests can be done until 12/31, 23:59 Server Time. Every quest gives you 1 Big IM Consumables Box and one collectable X-Mas item which can be exchanged for a winter themed car mount (Winter Rover) or a winter themed sheep mount (Frosty Flix). Also you will get a brand new X-Mas achievement.

[u]Please notice that the car/sheep is neither tradable/sellable nor account vaultable. Since the x-mas quests are beginning with Lvl. 20 we needed to restrict the eggs too to prevent abuse.[/u]


[b]World Drop[/b]
Collect [u]Burned Cookies[/u] to exchange them for different items:

-One EXP Biscuit for 10 Burned Cookies (1.9x EXP for 30 mins.)
[u]The Biscuit has to be used within one day. Otherwise it's expired.[/u]
- A Santa Feilon or Santa Griffon Mount for 20 Burned Cookies each
- A Santa Dark Flip Mount for 30 Burned Cookies.
- One Big IM Consumables Box for 40 Burned Cookies.

 

[b]EXP Event[/b]
When it snows in the lands of Dragon Saga you can have the chance to get a 10 minute EXP bonus randomly between 1.1x ~ 1.5x.

 

*This EXP Bonus applies to Channel 4 as well because it is a buff. If you don't need the bonus EXP it can be cancelled by right clicking on the buff icon in the upper left corner.

 

[b][u][u]Please notice that all collectible items are neither tradeable/sellable nor account vaultable.[/u][/u][/b]


[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed


[u]Additions:[/u]
Rudolph Set
Tree Man Set
Snow Bear Costume
Snowman Costume
Santa of the South Pole Set
Dandy Pengiun Costume
Dashing through the Snow Set
Rudolph Rabbit Set

[b]MixBoard[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Choco Bear Costume [Advanced Tab]
Ice Penguin Costume [Advanced Tab]
Lovely Penguin Costume [Advanced Tab]
Black Bear Costume [Advanced Tab]

Christmas Feary Set [Special Tab]
Grey Dotted Blazer [Special Tab]
Semi Formal Night Set [Special Tab]
Purple Wizard ([u]Human only[/u]) [Special Tab]

Snow Emperor Set  [Deluxe Tab]
Zeus Set [Deluxe Tab]
Fantasy Fox Set [Deluxe Tab]
Cute Blue Messenger Set ([u]Human only[/u]) [Deluxe Tab]

The Silver Coin drop rate has been increased to 4% for this week.

The election period is over. You can get a small present from the winner which can be found at Port of the Winds. Also you can get the Winner's Accessory Set from the Vending Machine for 75 Gada Coins and 25 Silver Coins. The accessories and the present are fully restricted.

·         The event reinforced enchant insurance scroll can now be used for soul crafting

·         The event reinforced enchant insurance scroll can now be used for applying a socket card (Event versions of the scroll will automatically be used before the normal versions)

Lv. 50~59  x1.25, Lv. 60~69  x1.5,  Lv. 70+  x2.0

[b]Husky
Griffon
Phelix[/b]

The [u]Poring Pet [/u]is in the Item Mall until [u]11/30[/u] for 2[u]50 IM Points[/u]. It can be found in the [u]Event[/u] tab of the Item Mall.

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]

 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.20, Game Version: 10.1.0.7

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2016-11-16, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b]Arcadia Episode 2 Mini Update Unlock Event[/b]

You made it! At the time this patch notes are written we have reached 821 points. This is great! You have unlocked all goals and exceeded all expectations! So you unlocked another special reward we just added. Thank you, Dragon Saga Community!

 

[b]Goal #1: 350 Points [/b]Unlocked!

[u]Boosted Weekend EXP Rates[/u]
You will get the following rates on the next weekend:
Friday, 11/18: 3.0x
Saturday, 11/19: 3.1x
Sunday, 11/20: 3.2x

[b]Goal #2: 450 Points [/b]Unlocked!

[u]Mini Update to the Game[/u]
You have unlocked the Arcadia Episode 2 Mini Update and now we will reveal what it is: a 3rd Equip Page only for cosmetic costumes.

Ever wanted to have your personal look without missing out on stats? This is now possible. Just wear a costume on top of your IM gear (for ex Devil's Set of Agility or [Best] Unity Set). You're now free to create the look you want – mix and match whatever you like! You are now able to look as you want without giving up your stats. Every IM costume piece is working on both IM gear and Costume page. The difference is that every piece you put on the costume page will have it's stats disabled for the time you have equipped it on any costume slot.

 

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/events/Arca2/costume.jpg[/img]

 

 

[u]How to use it[/u]
If the costume page is open (by clicking on the costume button) just double click the IM costume part you want to equip at your inventory and this costume part will be automatically equiped on the right slot as costume. Alternatively you can drag and drop the part your want to the slot.
If your costume page is not visible double clicking an IM costume part puts the item automatically to the IM gear slot.

 

[u]But this is not all! For the 2nd goal we also added a world drop![/u]
Collect 15 "Likes" and you can trade them for a Big Event Costume Box at the Vending Machine. This box contains a lot of event costumes to trade or keep. However, once equipped they're soulbound.

[u]The box contains the following costumes (including so far unreleased costumes):[/u]
Pink Baseball Groupy Costume (female)
White Baseball Groupy Costume (female)
White Baseball Costume (unisex)
Black Baseball Costume (unisex)
Blue Basketball Uniform (unisex)
White Basketball Uniform (unisex)
Chic Modern Costume (unisex)
Traditional Outdoor Outfit (unisex)
Serious Business Suit (unisex)
Super Beetle Costume (unisex)
Jonathan's Suit (unisex)
Joseph's Suit (unisex)
Brindle Suit (unisex)
Leopard Suit (unisex)
Black Fedora
Navy Fedora
Red Fedora
Dandy Sunglasses
Matchstick

[u]The world drop is running for one week. The drop rate is at 5%.[/u]

 

[b]Goal #3: 550 Points [/b]Unlocked!
[u]Mystery Prize[/u]
Ever wanted the Community Appreciation Ring? Sorry, it stays exclusive and you won't get it. BUT we created a ring which as almost as good as the Community Appreciation Ring. Let us introduce [b]the I like! Ring. [/b]Just talk to Election Manager Gato and get your mystery prize. The ring is fully restricted including account vault.

 

[u]Stats:[/u]
Max HP +6.0%
Max MP +6.0%
Agility +6
Movement Speed +4.0%
Attack Speed +4.0%
Critical Rate +2.0%
Critical Damage +3.5%
Final Critical Success Rate +0.3%

 

[b]800+ Points!!!! [/b]

[u]"You didn't expect this" Prize (we neither to be honest)[/u]
But here it comes: Everyone gets a Big Cart Pet (7 Days) absolutely free. This Cart extends your inventory by 24 slots. When the Pet expires just feed it with Regular Pet Food. Even if the pet is expired the inventory content will be kept but is not accessible until you revive the cart. Please know this pet has no additional stats and is fully restricted including account vault.

 

[b]Vote for Dragon Saga's first President (Election Event)[/b]

The first presidential elections are taking place in Dragon Saga's world and you will be the ones who decide who it will be. Just go to Election Manager Gato and pick your candidate. Gato has a quest where you can pick one balloon which represents the candidate you want to vote for. Once chosen there is no way back. You have the choice between the following 3 candidates:

[b]Husky
Griffon
Phelix[/b]

 

To make your vote count you need to equip the balloon of your candidate either on the Balloon IM Gear slot or on the Balloon Costume Slot. You need to keep the Balloon equipped until the election event is over which will be in 2 weeks.

 

Please know that all 3 candidates are given a new accessory set with new stats that are different from the current "for president" sets. So pick your candidate because of sympathy and not because of the stats of the former sets!

 

The set of the winner will be put in the vending machine for being farmed with the ending of the voting period.

 

[b]Halloween Event 2016[/b]
The Halloween Event 2016 has ended. NPC Randy stays for another week to give you a chance to exchange the coins you might still have.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]
The Halloween Brooms (mounts), the Midnight Calm Mount and the Golden Dragon Mount will be removed.
The Flying Squirrel Mount will be added for 300 IM Points.
 

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Set of Unity
Sweetie Attendant Blue Set
Panda Doll Costume
Villain's Set

[b]MixBoard[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Sexy Red Dress (female) [Advanced Tab]
Drummer Popstar Set (male) [Advanced Tab]

High Priest Set (male) [Special Tab]
High Priest Set (female) [Special Tab]
Lucifer's Set [Special Tab]

Hephaistos Set  [Deluxe Tab]
Angel's Set of Health [Deluxe Tab]

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.15, Game Version: 10.1.0.6b

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2016-11-02, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b]Halloween Event 2016[/b]
Halloween Night is over but our event stays for 2 more weeks.
The Trick or Treat event will be ending.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]


Adjusted the Hunter G. and Guild Daily quests in the 10xx range (Lv. 65~69). More detailed infos will follow.

 

[b]Drop Rate Adjustment[/b]


The calculation for the monster drops has been reworked to make the dropping fairer. Instead of continuously decreasing drop rates with increasing difference between player level and monster level the decrease is now occuring in steps. One step is always 5 levels of difference between player level and monster level. Please refer to the tables below:

 

[u]Comparison char between drop chances before and after the maintenance[/u]
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/sudo/vm/2016_11/DropTable1.png[/img]

 

Please keep in mind, that the items themselves have an own drop chance which has to be taken into account. The charts below show 2 different examples of the old and new drop chances.

[u]Drop chances in case that the item has it's own drop chance of 50%[/u]
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/sudo/vm/2016_11/DropTable2.png[/img]

 

[u]Drop chances in case that the item has it's own drop chance of 3% (Silver Coins for example)[/u]
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/sudo/vm/2016_11/DropTable3.png[/img]

 

 

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

 

Want to enchant your items during the spooky season in Dragon Saga? Or upgrade socket cards? We are sure you need Insurance Scrolls. How about faster levelling too? Check out our [b]Trick or Treat EXP Package [/b]and get 10 Insurance Scrolls and 10 Reinforced Insurance Scrolls plus [b]2 Jack's Beans [/b]for free for 180 IM Points from the [u]Event[/u] tab in the Item Mall.

Also check out our cute and spooly Halloween Mounts for 300 IM Points each.

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed


[u]Additions:[/u]
Black Witch Costume
Red Devil Costume
Death Cheater Set
Odd Eyed Kitty Costume

[b]MixBoard[/b]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed except for Super Dragon Ranger Uniform

[u]Additions:[/u]
Halloween Ghost Set [Advanced Tab]
Skeleton Set [Advanced Tab]

Naughty Little Devil Set [Special Tab]
Delightful Pumpkin Costume [Special Tab]
Red Dragon Ranger [Special Tab] [u]*NEW!*[/u]
Pink Dragon Ranger [Special Tab] [u]*NEW!*[/u]

Jack O'Lantern  [Deluxe Tab]
[Best] Unity Set [Deluxe Tab]
Super Dragon Ranger [Deluxe Tab]

Patch Version 0.5.9, Game Version: 10.1.0.6b

[b][img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Facebook_Cover.jpg[/img][/b]

 

The spooky time is here. At the center of Port of the Winds Randy awaits you to give you some Halloween Quests. This year we're calling for teenagers with attitude that are willing to save the world from a neverending halloween night. As reward you can obtain one of 5 free Dragon Ranger Event Uniforms in Black, Blue, Pink, Red or White. You can only pick one so choose wisely. The sets are fully restricted (including account vault).

 

Also you will be able to obtain the little ghost costume by playing the daily mission quest. Along with that you can get all kinds of useful and not useful stuff like Halloween Accessories, Balloons and more.

The Event will stay for 4 weeks (until November, 16th)
Also the Halloween Races should be available too during the Event period

 

From the Halloween Maps you can obtains as mission rewards:

 

• Small Soul Box

• Armor Dust Box

• Weapon Dust Box

• Tiny HP Eternity Potion

• Tiny MP Eternity Potion

• Double Up EXP Potion (2.0x EXP for 10 mins)

• Halloween Coin Green (Arcade Mode)

• Halloween Coin Red (Chaos Mode)

• Halloween Weapon Box

• Pumpkin Weapon Box

• Money Bag

• Halloween Hair and Faces Boxes

• Beauty Gasha Box (New Hair Colors & Faces)
 

To enter the Chaos Mode (F2) you need a [New] Torn Invitation.

They are dropped from every "Spirit" monster in the Event Maps.
 

[b]Halloween Coins[/b]

All coins are tradable at NPC Randy.

• Green Coins (F1): 3 Coins for 1 Halloween Gasha Box [Arcade] (Humans or Dragokins)

• Red Coins (F2): 3 Coins for 1 Halloween Gasha Box [Chaos] (Humans or Dragokins)

• Blue Coins (F5): 2 Coins for 1 Little Ghost Costume Box

Dark Bat Balloon

Purple Bat Balloon

Halloween Pumpkin Hat (Human only)

This box contains many different IM Consumables ranging from low to high value.

[b][u][img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/Events/HW16/RangerFreePrev.jpg[/img][/u][/b]

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

Also special Versions of the Dragon Rangers have been added to MixBoard
The first two special versions are green are white.

These will stay for 2 weeks:

For the next MixBoard item rotation the other 2 special versions will replace the first ones:

[b]Dragon Saga's 6th Anniversary Event[/b]

[b][img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/851x315_Anniversary.jpg[/img][/b]

[u]"Without the past there is no future."[/u] [u]Let's do the timewarp…[/u]

It's time to celebrate Dragon Saga's 6th Birthday here at WarpPortal in a very special way. Join us in the present to save the past for an even better future.

After completing the questline you will get a medal and a surprise reward.

We don't want to reveal too much about this event just one thing: "No, it's not a bug."


[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

[b]MixBoard and Bigwheel[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes 09/14/2016
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.5.1, Game Version: 10.1.0.3

 

[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2016-09-14, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

[b][img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Banner_700x236.jpg[/img][/b]

The Welcome to Arcadia Event is running for another week.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/851x315_PirateDay1-e1473715048472.jpg[/img]

[b][u]"[/u][/b][u]Why are pirates pirates? cuz they arrrrrr"[/u]

The Pirate Event Season has begun! Another two weeks long event for you guys to enjoy! Captain Hookah has arrived in Port of the Winds after hearing about the awesome loot to farm with the arrival of Arcadia City, and he brought his own treasure with him. Show him that you're worth getting his treasures! Run the Pirate's Hideout! Mission Map, collect Shiny Diamonds (Mission End Result) and Bronze, Silver and Golden Woodie Statues (these are contained in boxes dropped by the Mission Boss Monsters) to trade with the Captain!

 

This is the same event that was run last year, brought back by popular demand. No new updates have been added as the Dragon Saga team is focusing on working on other new and awesome updates for Dragon Sagas future!

 

Full Event details from last year:

[u]Pirate's Hideout Event[/u]

[u]Arg me mateys! The great Pirate Hideout has been discovered in Dragon Saga!

There be a new event mission map in town, and it be for all level o' players past level 25, with monsters that scale to yer level! Run the Pirate's Hideout F1 Mission Map to obtain marvelous treasures in the form of mission rewards. 

Once ye have made it through the perilous gauntlet of Pirates and scallywags, at the end of this mission you will see two deadly bosses. One of them is the terrifying Hookah, but the other changes with the shifting sea! You will either face off with Alvida or Kalygon . Once you have battled these monstrous foes, they will drop grand pirate treasure chests! Be ye careful though, all monsters in the finale boss room will have to be killed to complete the map.

You may find inside this treasure chest a Slice of Cake, Yogurt, a Balloon, a treasure piece or, if ye be unlucky, junk! Don't worry though; you can always be selling the junk treasure for 10 silver to any shop NPC.

What about them glittery treasure pieces ye ask? The treasure pieces be needed to be exchanged to a Chucky's Clothing Gasha Box, which may be randomly yields a pirate clothing!

As fer them shiny mission end rewards, ye can get:

Repair Hammers
An EXP potion
Weapon Enchant Dust
Armor Enchant Dust
Souls
A Pirate's Weapon Gasha Box (only S~SSS Rank)
Pirate's Diamonds (only S~SSS Rank)

Ye can also trade 4 Golden Woodie Statues, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Woodie Statues at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Barter ye Booty' (level 25+). If ye be wanting to unlock this repeatable quest you have to complete Hookah's 'Enter th' Hideout' Quest (Level 25+) once on yer pirate fightin' character.

And if ye have some of them Pirate Diamonds, ye can trade 5 at a time at the Hookah NPC by starting the repeatable quest 'Shiny Diamonds' (Level 25+) for a Big IM Consumable Gasha Box which randomly yields IM Consumables.

So go get that pirate treasure, before the time is up, and those scurvy pirates sail back out to sea![/u]

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

·         [u]Galaxia Skill Socket Cards[/u] are now usable from Level 20~99. Card upgrading stays untouched at NPC  Crete for the time being

·         All F6 Rings are now socketable (also the lower level ones)

·         Added Achivements for collecting Advanced Elements in the amounts of 10, 50 and 100 which are giving 100, 500 and 1000 Rank Points

·         [u]Chitin Cape[/u] now has the correct Inventory Icon

·         [u]1* and 2* Socket Cards[/u] can be sold at NPC shop for 50 Silver resp. 1 Gold each

·         [u]Hydron Alpha Potion[/u] and [u]Wind of Revenge [Grade 1~5][/u] are now blocked from being used in PvP to prevent abusing of 100%+ damage reflection with a chance of 100%

·         The descriptions of all [u]Hydron Potions[/u] in general now show their actual effect

·         The monster kill count tooltip is now also showing what you will get when killing 400, 600 and 850 monsters

·         The Item Exchange dialog of the Soulsmith NPC can now be moved. Also the description text of this dialog has been corrected

·         Fixed a bug where the shop items are not visible after using the Buyback button for production master NPCs

 

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

The Golden Dragon Pet Egg will be removed. The Midnight Calm Pet Egg will be added (300 IM Points).

 

 

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]

[u]Talk Like a Pirate! Day Edition[/u]

[u]Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Pirate King Set
Pirate Captain Set
Pirate Worker's Set
Woodie Leg Set

[b]MixBoard[/b]
[u]"[/u][u]Take what you can, give nothing back"
– Pirates of the Caribbean

Removals:[/u]
Everything will be removed

[u]Additions:[/u]
Great Bear Doll [Advanced Tab]
Milkyway Raincoat Set [Advanced Tab] ([u]Let's welcome the Fall Season!)[/u]

Luminant Bat of the Sea [Special Tab] ([u]The bat is watching over the Pirates on the sea)[/u]
Red Tyranno Dinosaur Set [Special Tab]

Poseidon Set  [Deluxe Tab] [u](Hopefully the God of the Sea is able to keep Pirates away from the cities)[/u]
Hephaistos Set [Deluxe Tab]

notes.title: Arcadia Update Episode One! [Complete]
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/DRNA_Logo_Arcadia.png[/img]
[b]Features Revealed[/b]

 

[b]The new Element System[/b]

Starting from Level 20 you will get Elements Points  each level which can be assigned to the element of your choice.
[list][*]2 pts each level from 20~39[/*][*]3 pts each level from 40~49[/*][*]4 pts each level from 50~59[/*][*]5 pts each level from 60~85[/*][/list]
This is a total of 240 points.

You can assign a maximum of 100 points per element. Each of these points represent 5 element damage and resistance of the particular element if you have a a damage/resistance rate of 100%. Each player starts with a base damage and resistance rate of 50%. The rates can be increased with elemental gear (accessory, weapon, armor), the element booster items and from the socket cards.

 

The stats can be shown as "Element Rate Points" like "Fire Element Damage Rate +1" where each "point" represents additional 5% or it is shown in an absolute percentage value like "Fire Element Resistance Rate +5.0%". This way you can increase the damage and resistance of the particular element over 100%. 

 

Against PvE monsters a multiplier is used to strengthen the elemental damage effect. This multiplier starts with 5.0 for a Level 20 char and ends up with 2.4 for a Level 85 char. The multiplier decreases due to the increased base damage/resistance due to the assignment of the points.

 

To assign the points a new button has been added similar to the "new stats" button you are used to from level 60+:
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsAssign.jpg[/img]

 

The points can be assigned to the element of your choice:

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsAssignWin.jpg[/img]

 

Also the character info sheet has been reword to give you as much informations as possible about the elements and it's calculation:

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsChart.jpg[/img]  [img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsOverview.jpg[/img]

 

You will get one free Element Point Reset Scroll for all four element points at the Gato NPC when the char is Level 20+.
Element Point Reset Scrolls are available in the IM, seperately for each element or as one scroll for all four.


[b]New Socket System[/b]

 

The sockets have been renamed from 1th and 2th socket [img]https://forums.warpportal.com/public/style_emoticons/default/wink.png[/img] to [u]Stat Socket[/u] and [u]Element Socket [/u]for easier understanding.

Galaxia Skill cards stayed untouched for this update and are still upgraded and used in the known manner.

Socket creation can be also done at the Blacksmith NPC. Both sockets can be created separately, means an equip part can have a Stat Socket or an Element Socket only, or both of them.

 

As mentioned before, cards have been replaced, also the old system with the grades and stars are gone.

Instead of this a new socket card grade system will be introduced. Every card is available with a certain card level in three grades: Normal, Advanced, Special.

 

Stat Socket Cards are available in the following card levels and grades (the card level is represented by a star):

1* Normal, Advanced, Special
2* Normal, Advanced, Special
...
8* Normal, Advanced, Special
9* Special 

The 9* Special is the highest card which can be obtained in the game after the update.
Cards can only be obtained by getting them through card boxes (more on that later) up to 8* Normal. If you want to have a higher card you have upgrade them at the Blacksmith NPC. Also 8* Normal is the card representing the highest card currently in the game.
8* Normal HLT Card has HLT+36, like the [Lv.8] 10* HLT card had. 

All currently socketed cards are replaced by cards which have same or slightly higher stats. Unsocketed cards become useless as already mentioned in the information. Same for Socket Boxes, Socket Hammers, Socket Recovery Powder and the Socket Option Remover Scroll. If you want to socket a new card to an equipment part which already has a card socketed you can just socket it "over", the old card will be destroyed then. Or you can just extract the currently socketed card beforehand. This is also done at the Blacksmith NPC. The position of the cards on the equip stay the same. Exception:
[list][*]HP/MP Recovery[/*][*]PAtk/MAtk, PDef/MDef cards with absolute values[/*][/list]
These cards can be socketed on earrings as well from now on.

 

[b]Please look at the cards carefully. [/b][u]All cards with percentage values are usable for equip level 20~85.[/u] The others do have a level requirement according their card level:
[list][*]1* - Equip Level 20~85[/*][*]2* - Equip Level 20~85[/*][*]3* - Equip Level 30~85[/*][*]4* - Equip Level 40~85[/*][*]5* - Equip Level 50~85[/*][*]6* - Equip Level 60~85[/*][*]7* - Equip Level 70~85[/*][*]8* - Equip Level 80~85[/*][*]9* - Equip Level 80~85[/*][/list]
 

[b]New Element Cards[/b]

 

A similar system as for the Stat Cards has been implemented for the Element Cards. The old system of grades/levels and stars is gone and has been replaced by the same card level/grade system already mentioned for the stat cards.

 

The card levels and grades available to Element Cards are:
[list][*]1* ~ 4* as Normal, Advanced and Special Grade[/*][*]5* as Special Grade[/*][/list]
The highest card has been replaced by a 3* Special Grade card (except for the 5-element card which has been replaced by a 4* Normal). Cards can be obtained through boxes up to 3* Special. If you want a higher card you have to upgrade it at the Blacksmith NPC.

 

All cards affect the Element Attack or Damage Rate (depends if it's an attack or defense card).

 

Following card types are available:
[u]Fire, Ice, Nature, Dark, Fire/Ice, Nature/Dark, All Elements[/u]

 

Also the slots where attack/defense cards can be socketed have changed:

[b]Attack[/b]: Weapon, Gloves, Shoes, Necklace, Earrings, Belt

[b]Defense[/b]: Top, Bottom, Backpack, Shoulders, Head, Shield/Wrist/Kickball

The rings can be used for both - either an attack or a defense card, but not for multiple element cards. Only single element cards can be socketed on rings.

 

[u]If you have socketed a defense card on a future attack slot it will be converted to an attack card.[/u]

 

All cards can be socketed on Equipment Level 20~85.

 

[b]Socketing Menu at the Blacksmith NPC[/b]

 

All socketing is now done at the Blacksmith NPC and has been completely removed from the production system.

At every Blacksmith you will now find a menu called "Socketing" which opens a new socketing window:

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/SocketWindow.jpg[/img]

 

In this window you will be able to create the sockets, extract socketed cards and upgrade cards.

 

All of these tasks can be successfully done with in-game items and gold. The available IM items will only increase the success rate (and in case of upgrading protect your materials). Gold is always taken, no matter if an IM item is used or not. A socket card can never break in this menu. The only possibility to break a socket card is still when it's socketed because that process stayed untouched so far.

 

For socket creation souls and weapon/armor dust is needed (the amount corresponds to the equip level). Also Event Weapon/Armor Dust can be used. If event weapon/armor dust is in your inventory it is used first.

 

For socket extraction the needed materials depend on the card type (Stat, Element or Galaxia Skill Card). For Stat cards Souls and Weapon/Armor Dust is needed, for Galaxia Skill Cards 3 Star Fragments are needed and for Element Cards Element Blesses are needed. The amount of needed items depends on the equip level. The extraction success rate is 33%. You can use a certain amount of IM Socket Card Extractors to have a chance of 100% success and no further items are needed. The maximum number of extractors needed are 3. Also here: cards can't break.

 

Card upgrading can be done with the card or on the equipment directly by dragging the card or equipment part into the slot of the socketing window.

If a card which is equipped would not fit on the equip after upgrading due to a level limit (stat cards) the upgrading directly on the equip is not possible. You need to extract it first then. You will also get a warning if you want to upgrade a card which level limit is too high for the equipment your char can wear. Then upgrading has to be confirmed in a message box, but still can be upgraded.
 

The materials needed for upgrading also depend on the card type:
[list][*]Stat Cards:
High Energy Plasma (new item - more about how to obtain that later)[/*][*]Element Cards:
Advanced Elements from the Spiritual Drops[/*][*]Galaxia Cards
The upgrading process for these cards is still done at Crete[/*][/list]
Basic elements are no longer used (because of the massive duping) and can be sold to a Shop NPC.

 

[b]Obtaining Socket Card Boxes[/b]

 

The new socket card boxes are similar to the old ones. Following socket card boxes are available:
[list][*]Stat Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Attack Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Defense Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Recovery Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Special Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Fire Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Ice Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Nature Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Dark Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Fire Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Ice Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Nature Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Dark Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][/list]
The element card boxes can contain mutli-element cards like Fire/Ice (in the Fire and Ice boxes), Nature/Dark (in the Nature and Dark boxes) or All Element Cards (in all boxes).

 

The boxes can obtained either in the Galaxia Dungeon end rewards (as it was before), in the Element Dungeons for the particular element or from Gwen by exchange.

The items needed for this exchange are new. They are called:
[list][*]Mysterious Fragment (Fire)[/*][*]Mysterious Fragment (Ice)[/*][*]Mysterious Fragment (Nature)[/*][*]Mysterious Fragment (Dark)[/*][/list]
These items can be obtained as an [b]additional [/b]mission map end reward. Also, to open the boxes you need a key. The following keys are available:
[list][*]Bronze Socket Card Chest Key[/*][*]Silver Socket Card Chest Key[/*][*]Golden Socket Card Chest Key[/*][/list]
These can be obtained in the mission maps as an additional end reward too. The higher the level of the mission the higher the chance to get a golden key.

The better key is used with the boxes the higher is the chance to get a higher grade card from it.

 

Also obtainable as a new mission map end reward is the earlier mentioned High Energy Plasma used to upgrade the socket cards.

The additional items will be given from Rank S~SSS starting with the mission at Bearded Whale Coast.

 

On the left side of the new mission map end reward window you will get either one of the Mysterious Fragments or High Energy Plasma, on the right side you will get either a key or High Energy Plasma.

The keys, High Energy Plasma and the Mysterious Fragments [b]can not[/b] be obtained through IM. They are purely in-game.

The special reward is not available to F6/F7 modes and can't be traded. Account Vault is possible.

 

[b]High Energy Plasma[/b] can also be obtained by killing monsters on the field through the monster kill count reward.
You get [b]High Energy Plasma[/b] when killing 400, 600 and 850 monsters.

 

[b]Buyback Feature[/b]

 

Items which have been sold to a Shop NPC from the Equip and Cons tab of your inventory can be bought back at the same NPC you sold it to within 30 minutes. Most of the items from the Misc tab can't be bought back (there are some exceptions). If items can be bought back or not is stated at the bottom of the tooltip when hovering over an item in your inventory if a shop window is open.

Buying back items cost 50% additional buyback fee (in-game gold).

 

 

And the last info ...

 

[b]Arcadia City[/b]

 

Welcome to Arcadia City... no that's a bit too early... you first have to fulfill the Legend of Arcadia.

Arcadia City comes with 30 Quests (Level Range 65~68) in this first part of Episode 6. After completing all of them you will be the proud owner of 2 new medals and a Hero Sign of Arcadia.
Because of the new socketing system all Hero Signs have been made socketable.

 

As mentioned already additional content will be released episodic.

 

[b]Production System[/b]

 

Since the recipes for socketing stuff will be removed the Machinery profession looked a bit empty. We decided to add recipes for 3 new items to it.

With machinery profession you can now produce:

 

- HP Injections

- MP Injections

- EXP Devices

 

HP and MP injections work like the food items. They immediately fill your HP/MP with a specific amount depending on the level of the produced item.

EXP Devices give EXP buffs for 30 minutes. Depending on the level between 1.2x and 1.8x. The EXP Devices require a minimum char level to be used: 1.2x Lv. 20+, 1.3x Lv. 30+ etc.

 

[b]We - the Dragon Saga Team - thank you for your long support over the time the game didn't get any updates, for your loyalty and constructive criticism. [/b]

notes.title: Arcadia Update Episode One! [Complete]
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/DRNA_Logo_Arcadia.png[/img]
[b]Features Revealed[/b]

 

[b]The new Element System[/b]

Starting from Level 20 you will get Elements Points  each level which can be assigned to the element of your choice.
[list][*]2 pts each level from 20~39[/*][*]3 pts each level from 40~49[/*][*]4 pts each level from 50~59[/*][*]5 pts each level from 60~85[/*][/list]
This is a total of 240 points.

You can assign a maximum of 100 points per element. Each of these points represent 5 element damage and resistance of the particular element if you have a a damage/resistance rate of 100%. Each player starts with a base damage and resistance rate of 50%. The rates can be increased with elemental gear (accessory, weapon, armor), the element booster items and from the socket cards.

 

The stats can be shown as "Element Rate Points" like "Fire Element Damage Rate +1" where each "point" represents additional 5% or it is shown in an absolute percentage value like "Fire Element Resistance Rate +5.0%". This way you can increase the damage and resistance of the particular element over 100%. 

 

Against PvE monsters a multiplier is used to strengthen the elemental damage effect. This multiplier starts with 5.0 for a Level 20 char and ends up with 2.4 for a Level 85 char. The multiplier decreases due to the increased base damage/resistance due to the assignment of the points.

 

To assign the points a new button has been added similar to the "new stats" button you are used to from level 60+:
[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsAssign.jpg[/img]

 

The points can be assigned to the element of your choice:

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsAssignWin.jpg[/img]

 

Also the character info sheet has been reword to give you as much informations as possible about the elements and it's calculation:

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsChart.jpg[/img]  [img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/ElementPtsOverview.jpg[/img]

 

You will get one free Element Point Reset Scroll for all four element points at the Gato NPC when the char is Level 20+.
Element Point Reset Scrolls are available in the IM, seperately for each element or as one scroll for all four.


[b]New Socket System[/b]

 

The sockets have been renamed from 1th and 2th socket [img]https://forums.warpportal.com/public/style_emoticons/default/wink.png[/img] to [u]Stat Socket[/u] and [u]Element Socket [/u]for easier understanding.

Galaxia Skill cards stayed untouched for this update and are still upgraded and used in the known manner.

Socket creation can be also done at the Blacksmith NPC. Both sockets can be created separately, means an equip part can have a Stat Socket or an Element Socket only, or both of them.

 

As mentioned before, cards have been replaced, also the old system with the grades and stars are gone.

Instead of this a new socket card grade system will be introduced. Every card is available with a certain card level in three grades: Normal, Advanced, Special.

 

Stat Socket Cards are available in the following card levels and grades (the card level is represented by a star):

1* Normal, Advanced, Special
2* Normal, Advanced, Special
...
8* Normal, Advanced, Special
9* Special 

The 9* Special is the highest card which can be obtained in the game after the update.
Cards can only be obtained by getting them through card boxes (more on that later) up to 8* Normal. If you want to have a higher card you have upgrade them at the Blacksmith NPC. Also 8* Normal is the card representing the highest card currently in the game.
8* Normal HLT Card has HLT+36, like the [Lv.8] 10* HLT card had. 

All currently socketed cards are replaced by cards which have same or slightly higher stats. Unsocketed cards become useless as already mentioned in the information. Same for Socket Boxes, Socket Hammers, Socket Recovery Powder and the Socket Option Remover Scroll. If you want to socket a new card to an equipment part which already has a card socketed you can just socket it "over", the old card will be destroyed then. Or you can just extract the currently socketed card beforehand. This is also done at the Blacksmith NPC. The position of the cards on the equip stay the same. Exception:
[list][*]HP/MP Recovery[/*][*]PAtk/MAtk, PDef/MDef cards with absolute values[/*][/list]
These cards can be socketed on earrings as well from now on.

 

[b]Please look at the cards carefully. [/b][u]All cards with percentage values are usable for equip level 20~85.[/u] The others do have a level requirement according their card level:
[list][*]1* - Equip Level 20~85[/*][*]2* - Equip Level 20~85[/*][*]3* - Equip Level 30~85[/*][*]4* - Equip Level 40~85[/*][*]5* - Equip Level 50~85[/*][*]6* - Equip Level 60~85[/*][*]7* - Equip Level 70~85[/*][*]8* - Equip Level 80~85[/*][*]9* - Equip Level 80~85[/*][/list]
 

[b]New Element Cards[/b]

 

A similar system as for the Stat Cards has been implemented for the Element Cards. The old system of grades/levels and stars is gone and has been replaced by the same card level/grade system already mentioned for the stat cards.

 

The card levels and grades available to Element Cards are:
[list][*]1* ~ 4* as Normal, Advanced and Special Grade[/*][*]5* as Special Grade[/*][/list]
The highest card has been replaced by a 3* Special Grade card (except for the 5-element card which has been replaced by a 4* Normal). Cards can be obtained through boxes up to 3* Special. If you want a higher card you have to upgrade it at the Blacksmith NPC.

 

All cards affect the Element Attack or Damage Rate (depends if it's an attack or defense card).

 

Following card types are available:
[u]Fire, Ice, Nature, Dark, Fire/Ice, Nature/Dark, All Elements[/u]

 

Also the slots where attack/defense cards can be socketed have changed:

[b]Attack[/b]: Weapon, Gloves, Shoes, Necklace, Earrings, Belt

[b]Defense[/b]: Top, Bottom, Backpack, Shoulders, Head, Shield/Wrist/Kickball

The rings can be used for both - either an attack or a defense card, but not for multiple element cards. Only single element cards can be socketed on rings.

 

[u]If you have socketed a defense card on a future attack slot it will be converted to an attack card.[/u]

 

All cards can be socketed on Equipment Level 20~85.

 

[b]Socketing Menu at the Blacksmith NPC[/b]

 

All socketing is now done at the Blacksmith NPC and has been completely removed from the production system.

At every Blacksmith you will now find a menu called "Socketing" which opens a new socketing window:

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/arcadia/SocketWindow.jpg[/img]

 

In this window you will be able to create the sockets, extract socketed cards and upgrade cards.

 

All of these tasks can be successfully done with in-game items and gold. The available IM items will only increase the success rate (and in case of upgrading protect your materials). Gold is always taken, no matter if an IM item is used or not. A socket card can never break in this menu. The only possibility to break a socket card is still when it's socketed because that process stayed untouched so far.

 

For socket creation souls and weapon/armor dust is needed (the amount corresponds to the equip level). Also Event Weapon/Armor Dust can be used. If event weapon/armor dust is in your inventory it is used first.

 

For socket extraction the needed materials depend on the card type (Stat, Element or Galaxia Skill Card). For Stat cards Souls and Weapon/Armor Dust is needed, for Galaxia Skill Cards 3 Star Fragments are needed and for Element Cards Element Blesses are needed. The amount of needed items depends on the equip level. The extraction success rate is 33%. You can use a certain amount of IM Socket Card Extractors to have a chance of 100% success and no further items are needed. The maximum number of extractors needed are 3. Also here: cards can't break.

 

Card upgrading can be done with the card or on the equipment directly by dragging the card or equipment part into the slot of the socketing window.

If a card which is equipped would not fit on the equip after upgrading due to a level limit (stat cards) the upgrading directly on the equip is not possible. You need to extract it first then. You will also get a warning if you want to upgrade a card which level limit is too high for the equipment your char can wear. Then upgrading has to be confirmed in a message box, but still can be upgraded.
 

The materials needed for upgrading also depend on the card type:
[list][*]Stat Cards:
High Energy Plasma (new item - more about how to obtain that later)[/*][*]Element Cards:
Advanced Elements from the Spiritual Drops[/*][*]Galaxia Cards
The upgrading process for these cards is still done at Crete[/*][/list]
Basic elements are no longer used (because of the massive duping) and can be sold to a Shop NPC.

The new socket card boxes are similar to the old ones. Following socket card boxes are available:
[list][*]Stat Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Attack Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Defense Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Recovery Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Special Socket Card Box (Stat Socket Cards)[/*][*]Fire Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Ice Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Nature Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Dark Attack Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Fire Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Ice Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Nature Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][*]Dark Defense Socket Card Box (Element Socket Cards)[/*][/list]
The element card boxes can contain mutli-element cards like Fire/Ice (in the Fire and Ice boxes), Nature/Dark (in the Nature and Dark boxes) or All Element Cards (in all boxes).

These items can be obtained as an [b]additional [/b]mission map end reward. Also, to open the boxes you need a key. The following keys are available:

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

·         The World Emperor Woodie Event ends

 

 

[img]http://images.ds-glasshouse.com/events/summer16/SummerEventLogo.png[/img]

 

Summer is here and the temperature is rising. What could be better than going to the beach, jumping into the cool water and enjoying the summer sun? Fighting monsters and getting some nice event stuff for sure! Take your gear and help the small baby dragon [u]Yongha[/u] out with his problem at the [u]Summer Wave Coast[/u]. A lot of nice stuff is awaiting you.

 

When entering [u]Summer Wave Coast[/u] an instanced map with end reward boxes is ready for you. The map can be entered starting with Level 25. The levels of the monsters are auto scaling to the level of the party leader. The map can only be entered if the level difference of all party members is not higher than [b]5 levels[/b].

Some of the monsters are dropping an item which can be traded with the [u]Baby Dragon NPC Yongha[/u] for one of three boxes containing random stuff:



·         [b]Cool Summer Costume Box[/b]
contains 2 different event costumes which are fully tradable, but soulbound once equipped

·         [b]Cool Summer Rummage Box[/b]
contains a lot of summer accessory stuff including some highlights (see below)

·         [b]Cool Summer Pet Box[/b]
contains 3 brand new Lv. 20 Summer Pets (see below). Pet eggs are tradable, the pet itself is not.

 

 

 

As reward for completing the map after killing the boss you can get the following:

 

[b]Level 25~39:[/b]

·         Cool Summer Costume Box

·         EXP Double-Up Potion (10 mins.)

·         Money Bag

·         The Item which can be traded for the boxes

·         Armor Enchant Dust Gift Box (4 ea.)

·         Weapon Echant Dust Gift Box (2 ea.)

·         Soul Gif Box (14 ea.)

 

[b]Level 40~69:[/b]
Everything of the above [b]plus[/b]

·         [Event] Soul Craft Randomizer

·         Big IM Consumables Gasha Box

Everything of the above and the chance to get the IM stuff is slightly increased

[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

·         The [b]Have-a-Picnic Mini Event [/b]will end

·         [b]World Emperor Woodie Mini-Event[/b] will be running until June, 22nd


Collect some Devil Soul Stones, Gada Coins and Silver Coins and get a 4-part Emperor Woodie Set (contains Face Item, Back Item, Hat Item and a Balloon) with some stats and a woodi-ish design to show the beloved Woodie how happy you are having him as the world emperor!

[u]All items have to be farmed for the particular char, because they're fully restricted like ones from the "president events".[/u]



[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

[b]Vaults, Vaults, Vaults[/b]

Good things come to those who wait. Finally you will be able to obtain the [b]Guild Vault Expansion[/b] from the Item Mall (permanent) for 500 IM Points per additional Guild Vault Tab. But that is not all! Every guild will get it's full first guild vault tab made available completely for free. Also every newly created guild will get a full first guild vault tab after getting the guild vault from Dony.

 

But this is again not all! The [b]Character Vault Expansion[/b] (not the account vaults) will be permanent in the future. Just buy an additional tab in the Item Mall for 300 IM Points and you will get the additional space permanently. [u]Please remember that the character vault is extended per char not per account.[/u]

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

 

·         The [b]Midnight Scream Pet Egg[/b] has been removed

·         Added [b]I'm a Star! Glasses (Blue)[/b] to the IM for direct purchase (150 IM)

[u]New star shaped glasses in green[/u]

notes.notes:
Hello Roserians!
The maintenance is complete at this time and the following changes have been implemented:

[b]Memorial Weekend Sale[/b]

The following items will be available until June 1st:

 
[list][*]Honor Reward Bonus (30 Days) (20% Discount!)[/*][*]180 Days Premium Service[/*][*]Lucky Spin Coin Discount Box[/*][*]Box of Plutorunes[/*][*]Farmer's Package[/*][*]Re-Roll Hammer (100)[/*][*]Blank Enchantment Scroll (10)[/*][*]Item Unbinder (20)[/*][/list]
[b]Premium Account Time Compensation[/b]

Between the 8th to 12th May we experienced connection issues that prevented a significant number of players from being able to connect. To make it up to you for being so patient during these issues, we have given every active Premium Account 7 days of additional time, and every other account 2 days of Premium Account time.

 

[b]Help A Noob Event[/b]

The Help A Noob Event is active until June 1st!  If you want to help your friends boost their leveling speed, or you have a lowbie character you want to dust off and play again, this is the weekend for it!

notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DSPatchNotes.png[/img]
 
[b]Maintenance Notes[/b]
Patch Version 0.4.70, Game Version: 10.0.0.17c
[b]Server Maintenance[/b]
2016-05-25, 15:00 Server Time
 
[b][u]Note: [/u][/b][u]Patch notes are subject to change.[/u]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

·         The daily quest [b]Get my Point[/b] will be removed

·         Memorial Day Mini-Event:
You can get Have-A-Picnic boxes by killing monsters. By opening these boxes you have the chance to randomly get one of the following:

- A [u]Food Box [/u]which randomly contains: [u]2x Slice of Cake, 2x Yogurt, 3x Bread Roll, 3x Parfait[/u]
- A [u]Cookie Ingredients Box[/u] which gives you: [u]2x Flour, 2x Powdered Sugar, 2x Butter, 2x Almond Piece, 2x Chocolate Piece, 2x Stick, 2x Marshmellow, 2x Milk, 5x Sweets Recipe Gasha Box[/u]
- A Mithril Coin of which 15 of it can be exchanged for an [u][Event] Picnic Hat[/u] at the Vending Machine

The event will last until June, 1st.
 

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

·         The Puff Tower targets for [u]Kazeura Village[/u], [u]Red Fox Delta[/u] and [u]Fungoid Village[/u] have been fixed. The character now appears next to the Puff Tower of the particular location.

·         A "bug" that caused the character to be stuck until the end sequence is done at [u]Drakos, 49th floor[/u] has been fixed

·         The [b]Repair All[/b] option is now the default option if using the repair function of the blacksmith

·         The [u]Soulgrade [/u]is now written in the same color like the [u]Soulforce [/u]in the equip item description. This shall help to notice the Soulgrade especially for IM items.
Example: If an IM item has been soulcrafted to artifact soulgrade,  not only the text "Soulforce" is written in orange, but also the text "Soulgrade: Artifact"

 

·         The drop rate for the[u] Star Fragments [/u]dropped by the [u]Space Thief[/u] in the bonus rooms of the [u]Zodiac Dungeons[/u] has been slightly increased

·         The equip item stats for the [Best] Villain's Set have been adjusted to comply to a normal grade costume

·         The max. Level for the mission maps [u]Dragon Valley[/u] and [u]Edge of the World[/u] has been raised to level 85. This has been done to make farming and getting ranks (for example to do the daily quests) easier for end-level players. This applies only to Arcade (F1) and Chaos (F2) modes

·         The limit of 100 for stack division has been removed, now you can divide stacks in any amounts
 

 

 

[b]BigWheel[/b]

Everything will be removed

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Events.png[/img]

 

·         The daily quest [b]Get my Point[/b] will stay for another week.
Finish an easy job daily and get some skill points and hunter capsules.

 

·         The [b]Unity Accessory Box [/b]has been removed from the Vending Machine
 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

·         [b]Chain Combos:[/b] The new [u]Fast X-Shoot[/u] system has been adjusted a bit.

·         Since the Archer's Shootdown Skill bug has been fixed, the [b]Archer's Support Ring [/b]has been renamed to [b]Weapon GFX Ring [/b]and the [b]Dragon Fellowship Ring (with Archer's Support)[/b]has been renamed to [b]Dragon Fellowship Ring (with Weapon GFX)[/b]

·         [b]The Haven of Peace[/b] map is now shown correctly in the Party Search instead of Grass Wind Hills

·         Added Sadonyx (1g) to the NPC Syamalky at Vanshi Gorge

·         [b]Constellation Dungeons: [/b]The [u]Space Thief[/u] has now a very rare chance to drop a 1x [u]Star Fragment [/u]and an even rarer chance to drop[u] 2x Star Fragment[/u]

 

 

[b]Guild Daily Quests[/b]

 

[b]Besides EXP and Guild EXP you will now get a reward for every completed daily guild quest.[/b]

If you play daily guild quests in the Level Range 20~39 you will get a Dony's Support Bag (Level 20~39) for every completed daily guild quest, from Level 40+ you will get a Dony's Support Bag (Level 40~85) for every completed daily guild quest.

By opening one of these bags it [b]randomly[/b] yields one of the following items:

 

[u]Dony's Support Bag (Level 20~39)[/u]

·         1x Silver Coin

·         3x [Event] Armor Enchant Dust

·         2x [Event] Weapon Enchant Dust

·         1x Gold Pouch with 3 Gold

·         1x [Event] Skill Points [b]+2 [/b][u](rare)[/u]
[u]This is a new Skill Point Item that immediatley gives 2 Skillpoints when used[/u]

 

[u]Dony's Support Bag (Level 40~85)[/u]

·         1x Silver Coin

·         5x [Event] Armor Enchant Dust

·         3x [Event] Weapon Enchant Dust

·         1x Gold Pouch with 5 Gold

·         1x [Event] Skill Points [b]+2 [/b][u](rare)[/u]
[u]This is a new Skill Point Item that immediatley gives 2 Skillpoints when used[/u]

·         1x [Event] Soulcraft Randomizer [u](rare)[/u]

·         1x [Event] Jack's Bean [u](rare)[/u]

·         2x [Event] Enchant Insurance Scroll[u] (rare)[/u]

·         1x [Event] Reinforced Enchant Insurance Scroll[u] (rare)[/u]

 

[b]Important! [/b]All items which are given by these bags are fully restricted including the account vault. The bag is meant as a reward for the effort doing the guild dailies and helping the guild to level up. Different to the Hunter G. Capsules the Dony's Support Bags are also fully restricted and neither tradable nor able to be put in the account vault.

 

[b]Happy Jobchange Level 40[/b]

After having the effort to change to your next job at Level 40 and also getting [b]Lavalon's Fire Scale[/b] (by completing the quest [u]Fight to the death against Drake!)[/u] you can grab yourself the next[b]Happy Jobchange[/b] reward from [b]NPC Pablo[/b] in [b]Libra[/b].

Pablo will hand out a Jobchange Reward Box (Level 40) box which contains the following:

·         2x [Event] Good Shop License

·         1x [Jobchange] Inventory Expansion Bag
[u]contains an additional inventory row for all 4 inventory types[/u]

·         2x [Event] Jack's Bean

·         2x Defense Order: Mission Map

 

 

[b]Item Mall[/b]

 

·         The [b]Midnight Scream Pet Egg[/b] is still available (300 IM Points)

·         The [b]Blue Tail Lizard Pet Egg [/b]will be replaced by the [b]Sugar Glider Pet Egg [/b](300 IM Points, Event Tab)

·         The [b]Fire Guardina, Water Guardian, Unity and Zodiac Weapons [/b]will be removed from the Item Mall

         Finish an easy job daily and get some skill points and hunter capsules.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/DS-Changes.png[/img]

 

[b]Chain Combo Changes[/b]

 

·         The option whether Chain-Combos are enabled or disabled is now saved character-wise and no longer client-wise

·         The Chain-Combo checkbox location has been changed in the UI from the top of the Chain Combo overview page to the bottom (see image below)

·         A new option for the Chain-Combo behavior has been added: [b]Fast X-Attack[/b]

If this option is checked, holding down the attack key (standard key 'X', X-Attack) results in a fast constantly attack of the first X-Combo of all classes. This does not affect the usual manually "X-Spamming" or the execution of chain combo combinations.

[b]This new option only works if Chain-Combos are enabled and is greyed out if Chain-Combos are disabled!

Server Maintenance
2016-03-23, 15:00 Server Time
 
Note: Patch notes are subject to change.
 

 
The Easter Cherry Blossom Event is here!
 
Haruka is back, and she needs your help to stop the chef from causing trouble! But that is not all. The Little Spring Fairy Alba needs your help in the Easter Forest as well! Both NPCs can be found at the center island in Ports of the Winds.
 
Collect Easter Eggs to exchange them with Alba for great stuff. You can trade them for:
 
·         Cherry Blossom Costume Accessory Gasha Box

·         Easter Balloon Gasha Box
·         Kimono/Spring Party Set Gasha Box
·         Soverign Sunflower Set Gasha Box

notes.notes:
[h1]Dragon Saga Patch Notes 1/27/2016[/h1]

Maintenance Notes
Patch Version 0.4.31
Server Maintenance
2015-01-27, 15:00 Server Time
 
Note: Patch notes are subject to change.
 
 
Mini-Event
 
The presidency of Husky is over now, but there is already a new candidate: Vote Phelix for President!
 
For 75 Gada Coins and 25 Silver Coins each you can get a Phelix for President Collar and a Phelix for President Snout. Both items give +0.3% Final Critical Success Rate. If you wear both you get additional 0.4% Final Critical Success Rate and +5.0% Critical Damage. You can get the items at the Vending Machine. Please notice that these items are fully restricted which means: No trade, no open-market, no mail attachment, no account vaulting.
 
New Hidden Map for Level 70+ "Secret Lava Cave"
This new hidden map is a re-worked version of the old "Secret Basement Storage" hidden map to be appropriate for the level ranges 70-85. The monsters have been set to level 71~74 and also the drops match this level ranges. The Secret Lava Cave Hidden Scroll can be obtained from Alexandre, Kryos, Carsharp and Prokell as possible drop in F1 and F2 missions.
 
Adjustments to Hunter G. and Guild Dailies for Levels 50~54
We have made several adjustments to the daily quests for the Level Ranges:
 
Hunter G's 706th
Decreased the amount of needed Gremlins from 33 to 23
Hunter G's 707th
Decreased the amount of needed Poisonous Tree Spirit from 2 to 1
Hunter G's 708th
Decreased the amount of needed Lava Rake from 33 to 15
Hunter G's 709th
Decreased the amount of needed Sticky Brown Fluid from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 711th
Decreased the amount of needed Shroom Blood from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 713th
Decreased the amount of needed Venom Stinger Mask from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 715th
Increased the drop rate of Moth Wing from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 716th
Decreased the amount of needed Mimir Kahuna from 33 to 23.
Hunter G's 717th
Decreased the amount of needed Bandana from 13 to 9. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 720th
Increased the drop rate of Zard Warrior Helment from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 721st
Decreased the amount of needed Red Zard from 33 to 23.
Dony's 706th
Decreased the amount of needed Lagon from 33 to 15.
Dony's 707th
Decreased the amount of needed Rotten Tree Spirit from 2 to 1.
Dony's 708th
Decreased the amount of needed Shroom Soldier from 33 to 23.
Dony's 709th
Decreased the amount of needed Dark Soul from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Dony's 713th
Decreased the amount of needed Porky from 33 to 23.
Dony's 714th

Additionally we have made changes to the following quests:
Counterattack of Hor (2) and Counterattack of Hor (3) can now be also completed in the Gods' Sanctuary Mission Maps.
Finding Medicine now only needs 25 instead of 50 Remed of Hermes.
 
New Schedules for the Community Dungeons and Race
On community wish we have added additional (EU and SEA) friendly schedules for the Community Dungeons and the Race. Additionally the Community Dungeons can now be played with or without PvP option. Also there should be no longer the need to form a party to enter the community dungeon. The need of creating a party seemed to be senseless due to the fact that no party options are available after entering the Community Dungeon.

If you wear both you get additional 0.4% Final Critical Success Rate and +5.0% Critical Damage. You can get the items at the Vending Machine. Please notice that these items are fully restricted which means: No trade, no open-market, no mail attachment, no account vaulting.
 
New Hidden Map for Level 70+ "Secret Lava Cave"
This new hidden map is a re-worked version of the old "Secret Basement Storage" hidden map to be appropriate for the level ranges 70-85. The monsters have been set to level 71~74 and also the drops match this level ranges. The Secret Lava Cave Hidden Scroll can be obtained from Alexandre, Kryos, Carsharp and Prokell as possible drop in F1 and F2 missions.
 
Adjustments to Hunter G. and Guild Dailies for Levels 50~54
We have made several adjustments to the daily quests for the Level Ranges:
 
Hunter G's 706th
Decreased the amount of needed Gremlins from 33 to 23
Hunter G's 707th
Decreased the amount of needed Poisonous Tree Spirit from 2 to 1
Hunter G's 708th
Decreased the amount of needed Lava Rake from 33 to 15
Hunter G's 709th
Decreased the amount of needed Sticky Brown Fluid from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 711th
Decreased the amount of needed Shroom Blood from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 713th
Decreased the amount of needed Venom Stinger Mask from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 715th
Increased the drop rate of Moth Wing from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 716th
Decreased the amount of needed Mimir Kahuna from 33 to 23.
Hunter G's 717th
Decreased the amount of needed Bandana from 13 to 9. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 720th
Increased the drop rate of Zard Warrior Helment from 40% to 50%.
Hunter G's 721st
Decreased the amount of needed Red Zard from 33 to 23.
Dony's 706th
Decreased the amount of needed Lagon from 33 to 15.
Dony's 707th
Decreased the amount of needed Rotten Tree Spirit from 2 to 1.
Dony's 708th
Decreased the amount of needed Shroom Soldier from 33 to 23.
Dony's 709th
Decreased the amount of needed Dark Soul from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Dony's 713th
Decreased the amount of needed Porky from 33 to 23.
Dony's 714th
Increased the drop rate of Rotten Banana from 40% to 50%.
Dony's 715th
Decreased the amount of needed Angry Toenail Wing Patrol from 33 to 23.
Dony's 716th
Decreased the amount of needed Shroom Pants from 13 to 9. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
Dony's 719th
Decreased the amount of needed Pooka Primy from 33 to 23.
Dony's 720th
Increased the drop rate of Zard Ear from 40% to 50%.
Dony's 721th
Decreased the amount of needed Pooka Tory from 33 to 23.
Dony's 716th
Decreased the amount of needed Yeti Angakoq Ice Staff Head from 13 to 8. Also the drop rate has increased from 40% to 50%.
 
Additionally we have made changes to the following quests:
Counterattack of Hor (2) and Counterattack of Hor (3) can now be also completed in the Gods' Sanctuary Mission Maps.
Finding Medicine now only needs 25 instead of 50 Remed of Hermes.
 
New Schedules for the Community Dungeons and Race
On community wish we have added additional (EU and SEA) friendly schedules for the Community Dungeons and the Race. Additionally the Community Dungeons can now be played with or without PvP option. Also there should be no longer the need to form a party to enter the community dungeon. The need of creating a party seemed to be senseless due to the fact that no party options are available after entering the Community Dungeon.
